raw.title: Director of Cloud infrastructure and security
raw.description:
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global online marketplace for desirable pre-loved fashion. Our mission is to transform the fashion industry for a more sustainable future by empowering our community to promote the circular fashion movement. Vestiaire was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, Ho Chi Minh, and warehouses in Tourcoing (France), Crawley (UK), Hong Kong and New York.

We currently have a diverse global team of 600 employees representing more than 50 nationalities. Our values are Activism, Transparency, Dedication and Greatness and Collective.

About the Role:

Vestiaire Collective runs a global marketplace on AWS and GCP — Kubernetes, Kafka, Terraform, Vault, Cloudflare, Datadog, a large PHP application under active modernisation, a series of microservices in different tech stacks (Goland, PHP, Node) and a fast-growing surface of AI-powered services. 

 

As Director of Cloud Infrastructure and Security, you will lead a small team of six senior individual contributors across Cloud Infrastructure (DevOps/SRE) and Security. This is a hands-on Director role: alongside setting the strategy and roadmap, you will work directly with the team on architecture, technical decisions, incidents and delivery. You will be accountable, alongside Product Development teams, for the reliability, cost-efficiency and security posture of everything we run in production.

What you will do:

Leadership across two teams

  • Directly lead, develop and retain a small team of six (6) experienced engineers across Cloud Infrastructure and Security. This is a player-coach role without multiple management layers, so you will remain close to the team’s technical work and day-to-day priorities.

  • Define a joint roadmap for both teams, aligned to business priorities and risk appetite, and make explicit calls on what we will not do.

  • Establish clear KPIs, SLOs and risk metrics, and report regularly to leadership on reliability, cost and security posture.

  • Set the operating model: what product teams self-serve behind guardrails versus what your teams own centrally. 

  • Foster a culture where reliability and security are shared accountabilities, not tickets thrown over a wall, including establishing a Security Champions model across engineering.

Cloud infrastructure, reliability and platform

  • Own our AWS and GCP footprint end to end: EKS, networking, secrets (Vault), data stores (RDS/Aurora, MSK, ElastiCache, MongoDB Atlas, OpenSearch) and the edge (Cloudflare).

  • Establish real reliability engineering practice: SLOs and error budgets, capacity planning, and a business continuity plan.

  • Drive infrastructure-as-code maturity: Automating Terraform change application, advancing our move to GitOps (ArgoCD), and enforcing guardrails at creation time with policy-as-code (Kyverno/OPA) so provisioning is safe, self-serve and reviewable.

  • Consolidate observability into a single source of truth for metrics, logs and traces.

  • Improve developer experience and delivery throughput: CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), paved roads, test environments on demand, and delivery metrics that hold up.

  • Own FinOps: infrastructure cost per unit of business value, cost accountability pushed back to each team, and continued run-rate reduction. Cost discipline is a first-class objective.

  • Support the modernisation of our core platform: Tech migrations, runtime and framework upgrades, and continuous database and Kubernetes upgrades.

  • Attack toil systematically: automate the recurring requests, and hand safe self-service back to product teams rather than absorbing the work.

  • Grow the foundations for AI-augmented engineering and operations

Security

  • Own security strategy and posture across cloud, application, identity, detection and response, building and improving the governance: risk register, published roadmap, remediation SLAs, and a recurring reporting cadence for leadership.

  • Strengthen cloud security posture management (CNAPP) and secure-by-default configurations across all environments.

  • Improve Embedding security into the SDLC and CI/CD: establish full static-analysis and dependency-scanning coverage with clear criteria for when critical findings block a release.

  • Mature vulnerability management, penetration testing and our bug bounty program into one prioritised program with SLAs and aging reports that measurably reduce risk.

  • Advance identity and access management toward least privilege and zero trust: automated provisioning from groups, and periodic access reviews.

  • Mature logging, detection and incident response, closing SIEM coverage gaps

  • Set guardrails for safe AI adoption (shadow AI outside approved paths, data and prompt leakage, prompt injection, model abuse) and defend against AI-enabled fraud and phishing.

  • Ensure compliance with GDPR, PCI DSS v4, NIS2, and CIS v8, including a maintained, reusable evidence library rather than evidence gathered on request.

  • Collaboration with legal and finance teams on compliance and forensic investigation topics

  • Manage third-party and supply-chain risk with vendor tiering and a recurring review cadence.

  • Own the security-built services your team already runs (back-office authentication and ACL, banning/fraud tooling, phone verification) and decide what to keep, hand over or retire.

  • Own endpoint security and partner closely with Corporate IT on device and identity coverage.

  • Keep security awareness and training relevant to a threat landscape that now includes AI-enabled social engineering.

Who you are:

  • 8+ years with a Significant experience in Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE or Cloud Security, including experience leading engineers.

  • You may currently be an Engineering Manager, Senior Engineering Manager or Head of who is ready to broaden your scope and step into a first Director role.

  • Strong practical experience with public cloud, ideally AWS, Kubernetes and Infrastructure-as-Code, with the willingness to remain close to architecture, incidents and technical delivery.

  • Track record establishing reliability practice at scale — SLOs, incident management, on-call, capacity planning, disaster recovery.

  • Demonstrable cloud cost optimisation / FinOps results at meaningful scale.

  • Strong grounding in cloud and application security fundamentals — IAM, network security, secrets management, CSPM, OWASP Top 10 — and the judgement to know when to hire the depth you don't have.

  • Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (GDPR, DORA, PCI DSS, NIS2) and how to turn requirements into practical controls.

  • Excellent communication skills: able to make a technical trade-off legible to a CFO and a risk decision legible to an engineer.

  • Comfortable operating with a lean team — ruthless prioritisation, automation over headcount, pragmatism over perfection.

 

Our Tech Stack includes:

We’re laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services. Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot , Polkadot SDK , and Kusama — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet. Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications. About the Team Parity’s Security Engineering team is at the forefront of protecting the Polkadot ecosystem by designing and implementing secure software, auditing code for vulnerabilities, and building cutting-edge ML tools to automate security analysis. We work closely with development teams to embed security best practices across our open-source stack, ensuring that our blockchain infrastructure is robust, resilient, and secure by design. About the Role As a security-focused software engineer, you will go beyond traditional application security - you’ll audit and ideally write secure Rust code where needed, conduct deep manual and automated code audits, and leverage machine learning to enhance security across our ecosystem. This is an opportunity to shape the security landscape of the next generation of decentralized applications and protocols. Assist in developing Secure Software – Write and optimise Rust code to build security-critical components and tools. Code Auditing & Vulnerability Analysis – Perform deep manual and automated code reviews to identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities. ML-Powered Security – Design and implement machine learning models for automated security analysis, anomaly detection, and threat mitigation. Bug Bounty & Vulnerability Management – Manage bug bounty submissions, triage security reports, and collaborate with ethical hackers to resolve issues. Secure Development Best Practices – Work with engineering teams to integrate security best practices into the software development lifecycle. Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment – Identify and assess security risks in our blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, and core software. Stay Cutting-Edge – Research and implement the latest advancements in secure coding, ML-driven security, and blockchain security. What We're Looking For Experience with secure coding practices and memory safety concepts. Background in code auditing, vulnerability analysis, or exploit development. Experience triaging and resolving bug bounty reports. Knowledge of machine learning techniques applied to security (e.g., anomaly detection, fuzzing, automated threat detection). Familiarity with cryptographic principles, blockchain security, or decentralized systems. Strong problem-solving skills and an offensive security mindset. If you're excited about writing secure software, auditing code, and pioneering ML-driven security solutions for Web3, we’d love to hear from you! About Working With Us Joining Parity means joining team mates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your team mates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats. Upon receiving an offer, all candidates undergo a background check through Zinc , our trusted third-party provider. Team members will be taken on as a contractor via our UK entity . View our Applicant Notice to see how we use your data. Parity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome. Is this position not quite your match? Browse our other open roles. TEILE entwickelt und produziert High-End-Lautsprecher, DJ- und Audio-Equipment sowie Merch – Design-Objekte mit kompromisslosem Klang, von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Produkt. Eine Brand, die man nicht nur hört, sondern auch tragen will. Unsere Lautsprecher prägen den Sound von ausgewählten Clubs, Festivals, Bars, Hotels und Restaurants weltweit. Hinter TEILE steht eine weltweite Community mit sehr hoher Reichweite auf Instagram – Menschen, die unsere Produkte nicht nur kaufen, sondern zeigen, teilen und weitertragen. Gerade bauen wir neue Vertriebskanäle auf: eigener Onlineshop, Social Commerce, Handels- und Objektpartner sowie Kooperationen mit großen Marken. Wir wachsen schnell – und bisher ohne Finanzfunktion. Es gibt kein Controlling, keine strukturierte Datenbasis, keine Systeme, die miteinander sprechen. Genau das baust du auf – von der ersten Zeile an. Deine Mission Du wirst die Person, die TEILE steuerbar macht. Du bringst den Blick eines CFO mit und baust trotzdem gern selbst – vom ersten Forecast bis zur Datenpipeline. Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit unserem CEO und dem Gründerteam zusammen und machst KI von Anfang an zum Kern unserer Steuerung: automatisierte Reportings, datenbasierte Entscheidungen und smarte Prozesse statt manueller Routinen. Deine Aufgaben Finance & FP&A aufbauen: Planung, Forecast, Liquidität und Reporting – mit einer Steuerungslogik, die mit uns skaliert. Profitabilität sichtbar machen: Deckungsbeiträge pro Produkt, Kanal und Projekt – von der Werkstatt bis zum Webshop. Finanzierung begleiten: Darlehen, Working-Capital-Finanzierung und Investoren-Unterlagen. Eine Datenbasis für alle: Shop-, Marketing-, Produktions-, Vertriebs- und Finanzdaten in einer Plattform zusammenführen (z. B. Shopify) – Dashboards statt Excel-Silos. AI-First denken: KI und Automatisierung produktiv in Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain und Customer Service bringen. Tech-Landschaft verantworten: Tools auswählen, Systeme verbinden, externe Dienstleister steuern. Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Finance, Controlling oder FP&A – idealerweise in einem produzierenden Unternehmen mit physischen Produkten Du hast Planung, Controlling und Reporting schon einmal selbst aufgebaut – nicht nur übernommen Ein Plus: Hintergrund bei einer Big-4-Gesellschaft (PwC, KPMG, EY, Deloitte) Datenaffinität: BI-Tools, Data-Warehouse-Logik, gern SQL – du baust selbst mit Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools und Prozessautomatisierung Strategisch denkend, hands-on, pragmatisch – du brauchst kein großes Team, um zu liefern Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse Ebenfalls ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Shopify und D2C Das erwartet dich Eine Schlüsselrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum – du baust deinen Bereich von null auf Direkter Draht zu CEO und Gründern, kurze Entscheidungswege Ein Produkt, das man hört: High-End-Sound an besonderen Orten weltweit Starkes Wachstum, neue Kanäle, internationale Projekte – und die Perspektive, ein eigenes Team aufzubauen Homeoffice nach Absprache Arbeitsmodell Standort Freiburg im Breisgau (Produktion) oder Berlin Vollzeit Regelmäßige Präsenz vor Ort an beiden Standorten Lust, TEILE mit aufzubauen? title: Senior Analytics Engineer - EMEA
description: Seeq builds advanced analytics software that unlocks insights from industrial process data—empowering companies in sectors like pharmaceuticals, oil & gas, chemicals, and power generation to optimize operations and drive business value. As a remote-first company since our founding, we’re built for collaboration across time zones. Our engineering and customer-facing teams thrive in a supportive, agile environment that emphasizes curiosity, learning, and continuous improvement. Analytics Engineers at Seeq serve as trusted technical advisors to our customers, helping them solve complex process challenges and maximize value from our software. You’ll work directly with end users to design scalable, high-impact analytics solutions that drive engagement, adoption, and tangible business outcomes.   Key Duties & Responsibilities: As a key customer-facing team member, you will participate in the following activities:   Customer Technical Adoption   Serve as the customer’s trusted technical advisor by building relationships with champions and end-users through solution design, implementation guidance, and technical mentorship. Leverage customer relationships to perform constant discovery and uncover high-value, high-impact use case opportunities directly linked to the customer’s critical business workflows and objectives. Collaborate with the customer and account team to develop and execute strategic plans for adoption of Seeq and completion of key use cases addressing business objectives. Advise customer champions and end-users to implement and operationalize the use cases to deliver a high return on investment for the customer. Occasionally may require hands-on delivery to accelerate a customer’s high value use case. Upskill Seeq’s partner ecosystem to be an extension of the Analytics Engineering team to provide support globally and in localized languages.  Product Expertise   Be a product expert, maintaining knowledge of how to implement and troubleshoot solutions in the platform, including integrations with other systems. Identify gaps in Seeq's capabilities required to meet customer needs and give feedback to the product organization to influence the product roadmap. Ability to assess and position Seeq’s benefits relative to competitive products in the marketplace or in the customer’s ecosystem. Work with the product team to design, implement, and test new functionalities that meet customer needs.   Industry Expertise   Build trust with customers through the application of industry-specific knowledge and awareness, including market and use case trends specific to their area.  Collaborate with internal teams (including industry principals, product marketing, and solution consulting) to influence industry-specific strategy. Requirements Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in a technical field such as chemical, mechanical, electrical, or industrial engineering; degrees in operations research, data analytics, or applied math will be considered. Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in process engineering, reliability engineering, technical pre-sales engineering (SaaS business, OT space preferred), or other related industry fields. Deep technical expertise in one or more industrial process manufacturing verticals and a sound understanding of broad market drivers and business priorities. Examples of industrial process industries are chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power & utilities, metals & mining, food & beverage, pulp & paper, etc. Empathy with and experience in the difficulties involved in trying to solve real-world business and industrial challenges involving dense time-series process data with inadequate or overly complex analytics tools, such as Excel, MATLAB, Python, BI tools, or otherwise. Responsive and adept at building trust and rapport with customers, prospective customers, partners, and internal multidisciplinary teams. Effective and influential technical communicator. Enjoys dissecting, articulating, and translating a combination of customer-stated and customer-implied needs. Able to communicate with subject matter experts, managers, directors, and C-level audiences. Creative ability to develop and propose technical solutions leveraging the latest features and capabilities in the software and broader technology landscape. Programming experience in Python and/or other programming languages is a plus. Ability to independently prioritize work based on account team strategy, customer business needs, and Seeq company objectives. Prior experience using Seeq is highly preferred. Python programming skills is a plus. Broad knowledge of the SaaS industrial analytics ecosystem is a plus (e.g., Azure, AWS, Databricks, AVEVA, Aspen Tech, IOTA, Cognite, C3.ai, Palantir, etc.). Benefits Seeq is a remote-first (only) company founded by serial entrepreneurs. Our executive team and board of directors have extensive experience with successful startup ventures in high-growth environments. We are founded on the idea that companies need better solutions for quickly and easily getting business insight from their industrial process data. Our mission is to provide software and services that convert that data into meaningful information that the business can use to improve profitability. We have a wonderful, kind-hearted, talented team that loves to collaborate, lead by example, and exceed our customers’ expectations. We are certified as a great place to work, an emerging startup, the Technology Fast 500, and Inc. Magazine's Best Places to Work. The Perks of Working at Seeq Competitive salary €111,000 - 129,000 depending on experience. Variable bonus Benefits: Unlimited PTO Generous home office allowance The best co-workers (we've analyzed the data, so we know it's true.) Pet-friendly workspace (your dog will be so happy to have you home) You love your job! Seeq provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. You must be authorized to work in the country in which you reside. Seeq does not sponsor US F1 or H-1B work visas Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Senior Analytics Engineer - EMEA
raw.description:
Seeq builds advanced analytics software that unlocks insights from industrial process data—empowering companies in sectors like pharmaceuticals, oil & gas, chemicals, and power generation to optimize operations and drive business value.

As a remote-first company since our founding, we’re built for collaboration across time zones. Our engineering and customer-facing teams thrive in a supportive, agile environment that emphasizes curiosity, learning, and continuous improvement.

Analytics Engineers at Seeq serve as trusted technical advisors to our customers, helping them solve complex process challenges and maximize value from our software. You’ll work directly with end users to design scalable, high-impact analytics solutions that drive engagement, adoption, and tangible business outcomes.

 

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

As a key customer-facing team member, you will participate in the following activities:

 Customer Technical Adoption 

  • Serve as the customer’s trusted technical advisor by building relationships with champions and end-users through solution design, implementation guidance, and technical mentorship.
  • Leverage customer relationships to perform constant discovery and uncover high-value, high-impact use case opportunities directly linked to the customer’s critical business workflows and objectives.
  • Collaborate with the customer and account team to develop and execute strategic plans for adoption of Seeq and completion of key use cases addressing business objectives.
  • Advise customer champions and end-users to implement and operationalize the use cases to deliver a high return on investment for the customer. Occasionally may require hands-on delivery to accelerate a customer’s high value use case.
  • Upskill Seeq’s partner ecosystem to be an extension of the Analytics Engineering team to provide support globally and in localized languages. 

Product Expertise 

  • Be a product expert, maintaining knowledge of how to implement and troubleshoot solutions in the platform, including integrations with other systems.
  • Identify gaps in Seeq's capabilities required to meet customer needs and give feedback to the product organization to influence the product roadmap.
  • Ability to assess and position Seeq’s benefits relative to competitive products in the marketplace or in the customer’s ecosystem.
  • Work with the product team to design, implement, and test new functionalities that meet customer needs.

 Industry Expertise 

  • Build trust with customers through the application of industry-specific knowledge and awareness, including market and use case trends specific to their area. 
  • Collaborate with internal teams (including industry principals, product marketing, and solution consulting) to influence industry-specific strategy.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in a technical field such as chemical, mechanical, electrical, or industrial engineering; degrees in operations research, data analytics, or applied math will be considered.
  • Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in process engineering, reliability engineering, technical pre-sales engineering (SaaS business, OT space preferred), or other related industry fields.
  • Deep technical expertise in one or more industrial process manufacturing verticals and a sound understanding of broad market drivers and business priorities.
  • Examples of industrial process industries are chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power & utilities, metals & mining, food & beverage, pulp & paper, etc.
  • Empathy with and experience in the difficulties involved in trying to solve real-world business and industrial challenges involving dense time-series process data with inadequate or overly complex analytics tools, such as Excel, MATLAB, Python, BI tools, or otherwise.
  • Responsive and adept at building trust and rapport with customers, prospective customers, partners, and internal multidisciplinary teams.
  • Effective and influential technical communicator. Enjoys dissecting, articulating, and translating a combination of customer-stated and customer-implied needs. Able to communicate with subject matter experts, managers, directors, and C-level audiences.
  • Creative ability to develop and propose technical solutions leveraging the latest features and capabilities in the software and broader technology landscape. Programming experience in Python and/or other programming languages is a plus.
  • Ability to independently prioritize work based on account team strategy, customer business needs, and Seeq company objectives.
  • Prior experience using Seeq is highly preferred.
  • Python programming skills is a plus.
  • Broad knowledge of the SaaS industrial analytics ecosystem is a plus (e.g., Azure, AWS, Databricks, AVEVA, Aspen Tech, IOTA, Cognite, C3.ai, Palantir, etc.).

Benefits

Seeq is a remote-first (only) company founded by serial entrepreneurs. Our executive team and board of directors have extensive experience with successful startup ventures in high-growth environments.

We are founded on the idea that companies need better solutions for quickly and easily getting business insight from their industrial process data. Our mission is to provide software and services that convert that data into meaningful information that the business can use to improve profitability.

We have a wonderful, kind-hearted, talented team that loves to collaborate, lead by example, and exceed our customers’ expectations. We are certified as a great place to work, an emerging startup, the Technology Fast 500, and Inc. Magazine's Best Places to Work.

The Perks of Working at Seeq

  • Competitive salary
    • €111,000 - 129,000 depending on experience.
    • Variable bonus
  • Benefits:
    • Unlimited PTO
    • Generous home office allowance
    • The best co-workers (we've analyzed the data, so we know it's true.)
    • Pet-friendly workspace (your dog will be so happy to have you home)
    • You love your job!

Seeq provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics.

You must be authorized to work in the country in which you reside. Seeq does not sponsor US F1 or H-1B work visas

title: Standortentwickler (m/w/d)
description: „Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“ Eine Stadt. Ein leeres Blatt. Dein Name drunter. Berlin hat rund 3,9 Millionen Menschen, zwölf Bezirke, zwölf Jobcenter, eine Agentur für Arbeit mit mehreren Standorten – und einen Arbeitsmarkt, der dringend Menschen braucht, die qualifiziert, gecoacht und vermittelt werden. Wir sind in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir in Berlin Fuß fassen. Richtig. Dafür suchen wir keinen Verwalter und keinen Vertriebler, der nach Feierabend abschaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Berlin kennt, in Berlin vernetzt ist und Lust hat, aus dem Nichts einen Standort aufzubauen, der in drei Jahren ein Name im Berliner Bildungsmarkt ist. Du bekommst dafür die Rückendeckung einer etablierten Gruppe – und du wirst am Gewinn beteiligt, den du selbst erwirtschaftest. Kurz gesagt: Du gründest unser Berliner Geschäft – mit uns im Rücken und mit Anteil am Ergebnis. Wer wir sind Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg sowie in Marokko. Seit über 15 Jahren konzipieren und realisieren wir geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprach- und Integrationskurse und Weiterbildungen – AZAV-zertifiziert, für Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Selbstzahler, national und international. Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Wir entscheiden schnell, arbeiten nah am Markt und nah an den Menschen. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity is für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag. Deine Mission Du baust das gesamte Geschäft der EuBiA in Berlin auf – vom ersten Gespräch mit einem Kostenträger bis zum laufenden Standort mit Team, Teilnehmenden und schwarzen Zahlen. In dieser Reihenfolge, ungefähr: Markt und Netzwerk – Du gehst von Tag eins auf die Agentur für Arbeit, die Berliner Jobcenter, das BAMF, die Senatsverwaltungen, Kammern, Verbände und Unternehmen zu. Du findest heraus, welche Bedarfe in welchem Bezirk offen sind – und wo wir mit unserem Angebot sofort einen Unterschied machen. Standort – Du suchst und bewertest Räume, verhandelst, richtest ein und sorgst dafür, dass der Standort die Anforderungen der Kostenträger und der Zertifizierung erfüllt. Angebot – Du entscheidest mit, welche Maßnahmen Berlin zuerst braucht – Coaching und Vermittlung (AVGS, § 45 SGB III), Weiterbildung (FBW), Sprach- und Integrationskurse, Firmenschulungen, Ausschreibungen – und bringst sie mit unserem QM-Team durch die Zulassung. Vertrieb – Du gewinnst Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Kooperationspartner, bearbeitest Ausschreibungen und füllst die Maßnahmen mit Teilnehmenden. Du verkaufst nicht nur – du hältst, was du verkaufst. Team – Du stellst Coaches, Dozentinnen und Dozenten und Verwaltung ein, baust die Mannschaft auf, führst sie und machst sie stark. Betrieb und Zahlen – Du verantwortest Budget, Auslastung, Ergebnis. Du kennst deine Kennzahlen jede Woche – Teilnehmende, Verbleib, Deckungsbeitrag – und steuerst danach. Hands-on – Am Anfang bist du alles gleichzeitig: Vertrieb, Coach, Verwaltung, Hausmeister. Das schreckt dich nicht, das reizt dich. Was du mitbringst Berlin – Du lebst in Berlin, kennst die Stadt, die Bezirke, die Akteure – und hast bereits ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Kostenträgern, Verwaltungen, Unternehmen oder Trägern. Du weißt, wer in Berlin was entscheidet. Arbeitsmarktdienstleistungen – Du kennst das Geschäft aus eigener Praxis: SGB II und SGB III, AZAV, AVGS, FBW, § 45, Ausschreibungen der Kostenträger, Integrations- und Berufssprachkurse. Du weißt, wie Maßnahmen zugelassen, gefüllt, abgerechnet und geprüft werden. Geschäftstüchtigkeit – Du denkst wie eine Unternehmerin oder ein Unternehmer: Du erkennst Chancen, rechnest sie durch, entscheidest schnell und bringst sie auf die Straße. Du hast schon einmal etwas aufgebaut – einen Standort, ein Geschäftsfeld, ein Team oder ein Unternehmen. Vertriebsstärke – Du gehst auf Menschen zu, kommst ins Gespräch, überzeugst und schließt ab – bei Kostenträgern wie bei Geschäftsführungen. raw.title: Standortentwickler (m/w/d)
raw.description:
„Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“

Eine Stadt. Ein leeres Blatt. Dein Name drunter.

Berlin hat rund 3,9 Millionen Menschen, zwölf Bezirke, zwölf Jobcenter, eine Agentur für Arbeit mit mehreren Standorten – und einen Arbeitsmarkt, der dringend Menschen braucht, die qualifiziert, gecoacht und vermittelt werden. Wir sind in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir in Berlin Fuß fassen. Richtig.

Dafür suchen wir keinen Verwalter und keinen Vertriebler, der nach Feierabend abschaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Berlin kennt, in Berlin vernetzt ist und Lust hat, aus dem Nichts einen Standort aufzubauen, der in drei Jahren ein Name im Berliner Bildungsmarkt ist. Du bekommst dafür die Rückendeckung einer etablierten Gruppe – und du wirst am Gewinn beteiligt, den du selbst erwirtschaftest.

Kurz gesagt: Du gründest unser Berliner Geschäft – mit uns im Rücken und mit Anteil am Ergebnis.

Wer wir sind

Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg sowie in Marokko. Seit über 15 Jahren konzipieren und realisieren wir geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprach- und Integrationskurse und Weiterbildungen – AZAV-zertifiziert, für Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Selbstzahler, national und international.

Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Wir entscheiden schnell, arbeiten nah am Markt und nah an den Menschen. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity is für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag.

Deine Mission

Du baust das gesamte Geschäft der EuBiA in Berlin auf – vom ersten Gespräch mit einem Kostenträger bis zum laufenden Standort mit Team, Teilnehmenden und schwarzen Zahlen. In dieser Reihenfolge, ungefähr:

  • Markt und Netzwerk – Du gehst von Tag eins auf die Agentur für Arbeit, die Berliner Jobcenter, das BAMF, die Senatsverwaltungen, Kammern, Verbände und Unternehmen zu. Du findest heraus, welche Bedarfe in welchem Bezirk offen sind – und wo wir mit unserem Angebot sofort einen Unterschied machen.
  • Standort – Du suchst und bewertest Räume, verhandelst, richtest ein und sorgst dafür, dass der Standort die Anforderungen der Kostenträger und der Zertifizierung erfüllt.
  • Angebot – Du entscheidest mit, welche Maßnahmen Berlin zuerst braucht – Coaching und Vermittlung (AVGS, § 45 SGB III), Weiterbildung (FBW), Sprach- und Integrationskurse, Firmenschulungen, Ausschreibungen – und bringst sie mit unserem QM-Team durch die Zulassung.
  • Vertrieb – Du gewinnst Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Kooperationspartner, bearbeitest Ausschreibungen und füllst die Maßnahmen mit Teilnehmenden. Du verkaufst nicht nur – du hältst, was du verkaufst.
  • Team – Du stellst Coaches, Dozentinnen und Dozenten und Verwaltung ein, baust die Mannschaft auf, führst sie und machst sie stark.
  • Betrieb und Zahlen – Du verantwortest Budget, Auslastung, Ergebnis. Du kennst deine Kennzahlen jede Woche – Teilnehmende, Verbleib, Deckungsbeitrag – und steuerst danach.
  • Hands-on – Am Anfang bist du alles gleichzeitig: Vertrieb, Coach, Verwaltung, Hausmeister. Das schreckt dich nicht, das reizt dich.

Was du mitbringst

  • Berlin – Du lebst in Berlin, kennst die Stadt, die Bezirke, die Akteure – und hast bereits ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Kostenträgern, Verwaltungen, Unternehmen oder Trägern. Du weißt, wer in Berlin was entscheidet.
  • Arbeitsmarktdienstleistungen – Du kennst das Geschäft aus eigener Praxis: SGB II und SGB III, AZAV, AVGS, FBW, § 45, Ausschreibungen der Kostenträger, Integrations- und Berufssprachkurse. Du weißt, wie Maßnahmen zugelassen, gefüllt, abgerechnet und geprüft werden.
  • Geschäftstüchtigkeit – Du denkst wie eine Unternehmerin oder ein Unternehmer: Du erkennst Chancen, rechnest sie durch, entscheidest schnell und bringst sie auf die Straße. Du hast schon einmal etwas aufgebaut – einen Standort, ein Geschäftsfeld, ein Team oder ein Unternehmen.
  • Vertriebsstärke – Du gehst auf Menschen zu, kommst ins Gespräch, überzeugst und schließt ab – bei Kostenträgern wie bei Geschäftsführungen.
  • Führung – Du hast Teams aufgebaut und geführt und weißt, wie man aus Einzelpersonen eine Mannschaft macht.
  • Zahlenverständnis – Budget, Deckungsbeitrag, Auslastung – du steuerst mit Kennzahlen und nicht nach Gefühl.
  • Qualifikation – Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung – betriebswirtschaftlich, pädagogisch, sozial oder etwas ganz anderes. Entscheidend ist, was du bewegt hast.
  • Persönlichkeit – Gründergeist, Ausdauer, Verbindlichkeit. Du hältst Unsicherheit aus, bleibst dran, wenn es zäh wird, und feierst, wenn der erste Teilnehmende einen Arbeitsvertrag unterschreibt.

Was wir dir geben

  • Gewinnbeteiligung – Du baust den Standort auf – und du bist am Gewinn beteiligt, den er erwirtschaftet. Die Details klären wir im Gespräch, offen und transparent.
  • Freiheit – Du entscheidest vor Ort. Wir geben dir Ziele, keine Mikro-Anweisungen. Entscheidungen fallen bei uns schnell – 70 Prozent Informationslage reichen.
  • Rückendeckung – Du startest nicht bei null: Zertifizierung und Qualitätsmanagement, erprobte Maßnahmenkonzepte, Verwaltung, Buchhaltung, Marketing und 15 Jahre Erfahrung im Ausschreibungsgeschäft stehen hinter dir.
  • Direkter Draht – Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung der Gruppe zusammen – kurze Wege, schnelle Antworten.
  • Perspektive – Wer Berlin aufbaut, leitet Berlin. Die Standortleitung ist der logische nächste Schritt.
  • Sinn – Jeder Mensch, den dein Standort in Arbeit bringt, ist dein Ergebnis. Das sieht man – jeden Tag.
  • Corporate Benefits und betriebliche Altersvorsorge – Weil wir auch an deine Zukunft denken.

Bewerbung & rechtlicher Hinweis

On a typical day, your tasks may include:

  • Creator network: finding and briefing creators at scale, from small accounts with loyal audiences to the ones that set trends, and keeping the ones that deliver

  • Launches: getting our products in front of the communities where they can travel, at the right moment

  • Trend spotting: catching formats and memes early and moving on them within days, not weeks

  • Experiments: running many cheap tests every week, with clear rules for what wins and what gets killed, and turning the winners into playbooks the team can repeat

  • New channels: finding places where attention is still cheap, from new communities to platforms nobody on the team is using yet

  • Organic and paid together: working with our Growth Manager so organic winners get scaled with paid, and what paid learns feeds back into organic

  • Measurement: knowing which number answers which question, for example what saves and shares tell you that views do not, and what each view really costs

  • Tooling: building the trackers, scripts and automations you need, with platform data and AI tools as your daily coworkers

 

Who you are

We're looking for a student or recent graduate who lives on the platforms and wants to learn how to make content travel.

Typically, your profile will look like this:

  • Platform fluency: you know TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts well and can explain why a post performs

  • Hands-on experience: you have grown an account, a page or a side project, or supported a startup or brand on social

  • Creator marketing: you enjoy working with creators and have a feel for content that looks native

  • Creativity: you bring fresh ideas and test them in a structured way

  • Analytical: you are comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets; SQL, Python or AI tools are a plus

  • Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

  • A big plus: you are a creator yourself, with a real following

  • Academics: pursuing or recently graduated with a degree at a top-tier university, with an outstanding academic record: grades, scholarships or awards to show for it

 

What makes this exciting

You own a lever the whole company feels. Every breakout you engineer shows up directly in how fast we can grow, at a fraction of what paid reach would cost. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.

We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together.

 

What the process will look like

We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP.

Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage:

  1. Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call, getting to know you

  2. Case interview: 90-minute case discussion, present and debate your skills

  3. Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO, going deep on all topics

  4. Offer, contract signing and onboarding

 

Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role.

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Product Manager in our Berlin or London offices.

About the Role

Taktile is building the world's leading Agentic Decisioning Platform for Financial Services. Our customers use our product to automate millions of critical decisions with AI across customer onboarding, credit underwriting, anti money laundering, and many other use cases.

Underneath every one of these decisions sits the Taktile Platform: the permissions, environments, deployment, extensibility and connectivity foundations that allow the largest financial institutions to run Taktile securely and at scale, for both humans and AI agents. Taktile Platform also owns developer productivity: the tooling, infrastructure and workflows that help our engineering teams ship quickly and safely. As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the strategy and roadmap for the platform, with a focus on its enterprise and agentic foundations. You will work closely with platform, infrastructure and security engineering to meet the demands of a rapidly growing enterprise customer base, and partner with customer-facing teams and Product Marketing to make our platform a reason customers choose Taktile.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the strategy and long-term success of the Taktile Platform, the foundation that every product area and every enterprise customer builds on

  • Define a compelling long-term vision for the platform and prioritize the roadmap necessary to reach it. Example areas of focus will include permissions for users and AI agents, Taktile MCP extensibility, release processes (e.g. environments), enterprise connectivity, and more

  • Build a deep understanding of enterprise requirements (security, IT, compliance and procurement), the competitive landscape and opportunities for differentiation, collaborating with customer-facing teams

  • Translate customer insights into well thought out product requirements

  • Balance innovation with a very high bar for reliability and security

  • Act as the voice of the platform: enable and advocate for platform capabilities across product, engineering and go-to-market teams, and partner with Product Marketing to bring them to market

  • Track adoption and performance of platform capabilities through metrics and customer feedback, identifying opportunities for iteration

Who You Are

  • 5+ yrs work experience in Product Management, including previous experience owning platform topics (e.g. identity and access management, permissions, environments, deployment models, connectivity or developer platforms) for B2B SaaS or AI products

  • Strong technical depth and an appetite to keep deepening it. An engineering or other technical background is preferred. You are comfortable going deep with engineers on cloud infrastructure, authentication and authorization (e.g. OAuth, SSO, SCIM) and networking. Experience in building critical, high-availability systems is a strong plus

  • Experience working with enterprise security, IT and compliance stakeholders, for example through security reviews, RFPs or complex customer deployments. Familiarity with AI agents and MCP is a must, familiarity with and with financial services is desired

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to build trust and influence decisions across functions, and to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences alike

  • Track record of delivering lasting customer impact through shipping well-thought out product improvements

  • Aptitude and appetite for using data to inform your decision-making

  • Hands-on, curious, and willing to challenge yourself and grow your scope of responsibilities over time

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you, and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here

  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy that allows you to make an impact and meaningfully impact a critical area of our product

  • Experience a flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe including the founders of Looker, Datadog, GitHub, and UiPath

  • Enjoy annual offsites where the entire company co-locates to collaborate in person

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package as well as access to a self-development budget

  • Work at our prime office locations in Berlin or London for three days per week or more

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com.

 

About Your Employment. Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). Sicherheitsketten eines Unternehmens im Rahmen von Advanced Cyber Attacks und Red Teaming Assessments auf die Probe Technisches Consulting : Du berätst unsere Kunden herstellerunabhängig zu modernen Sicherheitsarchitekturen, Angriffsszenarien und Best Practices und führst Audits / Whitebox-Reviews mit technischem Schwerpunkt durch Analyse & Reporting : Du bereitest technische Ergebnisse zielgruppengerecht auf, machst komplexe Angriffe verständlich und leitest daraus konkrete, umsetzbare Handlungsempfehlungen für unsere Kunden ab Research & Development : Du wirkst aktiv bei der Entwicklung neuer Angriffstechniken, Tools, Automatisierungen und Infrastruktur mit Gemeinsame Expertise : Du wirst Teil eines hochqualifizierten Teams, in dem jeder seine Spezialgebiete einbringt und gemeinsam zum Erfolg des gesamten Teams beiträgt Das bringst Du mit: Erfahrung : Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich IT-Security mit Fokus auf Penetration Testing und/oder Red Teaming Technisches Know-how : Fundierte Kenntnisse in Active Directory, Entra-ID, Enterprise-Netzwerken und/oder Cloud-Umgebungen (AWS, Azure etc.) OT/ICS-Erfahrung : Praktische Erfahrung in der Planung und Durchführung von Assessments in kritischen OT-/ICS-Umgebungen sowie in der Bewertung von Risiken und Ableitung pragmatischer Maßnahmen zur Stärkung der Cyber-Resilienz Development Skills : Programmiererfahrung, idealerweise in Python, Go, Java, oder C# Mindset : Du verfügst über eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und bringst neue Perspektiven in komplexe Security-Herausforderungen ein („think outside the box“) Kommunikation : Du hast Freude an der Beratung, bringst technische Inhalte klar auf den Punkt und kannst sie sowohl Fachteams als auch dem Management verständlich vermitteln Arbeitsweise : Du gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Reisebereitschaft : Du bringst eine Reisebereitschaft von rund 30 % mit. Dazu gehören gelegentlich auch internationale Reisen Nice to have : Zertifizierungen wie OSCP, OSWA/OSWE, CRTO, SANS oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen Was Dich aber vor allem erwartet: Ein abwechslungsreicher und vielseitiger Job in einem der (aus unserer Sicht) spannendsten Themengebiete überhaupt. Und das in einem Unternehmen, in dem wirklich jede Meinung gehört und geschätzt wird – vom Praktikanten bis zur Geschäftsführung. Uns gibt dieser Job nicht nur ein Gehalt, sondern auch persönliche Zufriedenheit, weil wir wirklich etwas bewirken und die Welt ein Stück sicherer machen. Bei uns gibt es (natürlich) kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und Snacks, aber das ist heutzutage Standard. Zusätzlich bieten wir auf Wunsch attraktive Benefits, von Jobticket bis hin zu Kindergartenzuschuss. Wir pflegen eine offene, vertrauensvolle Unternehmenskultur (schau mal auf Kununu) und schätzen eigenständiges Arbeiten, natürlich auch, aber nicht nur im Home-Office. Schließlich haben wir ein modernes Büro in Garching mit sensationellem Alpenblick, in dem wir gerne gemeinsam Mittagsessen und uns mit unseren Security-Auditoren, Incident-Respondern, Awareness-Trainern und Multimedia-Designern austauschen. title: Solution & Service Manager
description: Über SAJ: SAJ ist ein globaler Hersteller und Innovator von intelligenten Energiespeicherlösungen. Seit der Gründung im Jahr 2005 bietet das Unternehmen zudem fortschrittliche Produkte in den Bereichen Stromerzeugung und Industrieautomation. Unter dem Leitgedanken „Technologiegetrieben und serviceorientiert“ deckt SAJ die komplette Wertschöpfungskette von der Forschung und Entwicklung (F&E) über die Produktion bis hin zu Betrieb und Service ab. Mit einer erfolgreichen Lokalisierungsstrategie und Präsenz in über 80 Ländern verfolgt das Unternehmen das klare Ziel, die weltweit führende Marke der Branche zu werden und durch sichere, zuverlässige Technologien aktiv eine grüne Zukunft mitzugestalten. SAJ是一家全球性的智能储能解决方案制造商和创新者，成立于2005年，提供智能储能、发电及工业自动化产品和解决方案。秉承“技术驱动，服务引领”的理念，SAJ构建了涵盖研发、生产、运营和服务的全价值链体系，致力于成为全球领先的智能储能品牌。目前，SAJ采取本地化营销策略，业务遍及德国、意大利、西班牙、英国、比利时、荷兰、澳大利亚、巴西等80多个国家和地区。未来，SAJ将持续为全球市场提供智能、安全、可靠的储能解决方案，共建绿色未来，成就美好生活。 Aufgaben Leitung und Weiterentwicklung des technischen Supports für die DACH-Region (Deutschland, Österreich und Schweiz), einschließlich der Festlegung von Prioritäten, Servicestandards und Arbeitsabläufen für das regionale Supportteam. Führung, Coaching und Unterstützung der technischen Supportingenieure, einschließlich Aufgabenverteilung, Kompetenzentwicklung, Leistungsfeedback und technischer Schulungen. Verantwortung für das Eskalationsmanagement bei komplexen Kunden- und Produktproblemen sowie Sicherstellung einer zeitnahen Ursachenanalyse, klaren Kommunikation und wirksamen Problemlösung. Definition und Überwachung von Service-KPIs, Reaktionszeiten und Problemtrends sowie datenbasierte Verbesserung der Kundenzufriedenheit, Teameffizienz und Supportqualität. Technische Unterstützung auf Expertenniveau im Pre- und After-Sales für Vertriebsmanager, Distributoren, Installateure, EPC-Unternehmen und Schlüsselkunden, einschließlich Produktauswahl, Systemkonfiguration, Installation, Inbetriebnahme und Fehlerbehebung. Aufbau und Pflege enger technischer Kundenbeziehungen durch regelmäßige Besprechungen, Vor-Ort-Besuche und Projektunterstützung. Planung und Durchführung von Produkteinführungen, technischen Schulungen, Webinaren, Workshops und Kundenveranstaltungen in der DACH-Region. Erfassung und Weitergabe von Kundenanforderungen, Marktfeedback und wiederkehrenden technischen Problemen an das Produktmanagement und die Forschung und Entwicklung sowie Nachverfolgung der daraus abgeleiteten Maßnahmen. Du hast bereits an Influencer-Kampagnen mitgearbeitet und kennst die wesentlichen Abläufe von der Creator-Recherche über Briefings und Content-Koordination bis zum Reporting. Du sprichst Mandarin auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und kannst sicher mit chinesischsprachigen Kunden und Geschäftspartnern kommunizieren. Du verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und kannst Dich in einem internationalen Arbeitsumfeld sicher verständigen. Du interessierst Dich für Social Media, Creator Economy und die Entwicklung des Influencer-Marktes in China und Europa. Das ist ein Plus Du hast sowohl auf Agentur- als auch auf Markenseite gearbeitet. Du kennst Plattformen wie Xiaohongshu (RED) und WeChat aus einem professionellen Marketingkontext. Du bringst Erfahrung in Kundenberatung, Präsentationen, Pitches oder Business Development mit. Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse, die Dir die Zusammenarbeit mit deutschsprachigen Kunden und Partnern erleichtern. Was Dich bei LunyOne erwartet Verantwortung von Anfang an: Du übernimmst eigene Aufgaben und Kampagnen und kannst Deine Erfahrung aktiv einbringen. Internationales Arbeiten: Du verbindest chinesische Kundenperspektiven mit der operativen Umsetzung im deutschen und europäischen Markt. Gestaltungsspielraum: Du kannst Prozesse, Kundenbeziehungen und unser Angebot mitentwickeln. Wachstumsperspektive: Du wirst Teil unserer Weiterentwicklung und kannst gemeinsam mit dem Unternehmen Verantwortung übernehmen. Regelmäßige Team-Events & -Reisen Mission Statement Wir verbinden Brands, Creator und Communities für echten, nachhaltigen Erfolg. Du wirst in einem energiegeladenen Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen arbeiten. Wir suchen daher eine proaktive Persönlichkeit mit Hands-on-Mentalität, die Teil eines beweglichen Teams sein wird, das schnell auf neue Trends reagiert. About CircuitHub

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

The Role

CircuitHub makes electronics on demand. Engineers upload a circuit board design; we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them.

These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs:

  • They inspect boards. An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts.

  • They program robots. Agents read datasheets so our pick-and-place machines know how to handle each new part.

  • They watch the factory. They spot stray parts in robot storage, diagnose printer faults and clear stuck machines.

  • They run the back office. They book supplier invoices, chase late orders, explain quotes and triage bugs.

  • They write our code. Most of what our team ships starts in an agent session.

What you'll do

Find a process people still do by hand and automate it end to end: decide what needs judgement and what needs plain code, build the tools, and prove it works before it runs alone. Then make it cheaper, faster and right more often. You'll also improve the platform every agent runs on, and work closely with the people your work serves, from factory operators to finance.

How we build

  • Evals first. An agent earns the right to work alone: blind tests against people's verdicts, shadow runs beside the humans, replays of past decisions. We track accuracy and cost per run, and re-test whenever we change a model, a prompt or the effort level.

  • Agents judge, code writes. Agents return structured answers. Plain code checks them against a second source and makes every change.

  • Classical first, model second. Cheap vision and maths narrow the problem so the model only looks where it matters.

  • Safe by construction. Agents work in sandboxed cloud machines that never hold real credentials, and tool calls are built so a business action can't run twice.

Recent work

  • Image alignment ranks the parts on each board photo. The worst 20% of parts hold about 90% of real defects, so the agent only inspects those. In a blind re-run it caught all 13 defects operators had marked.

  • A photo check for stray parts in robot storage scored 10 out of 10 blind, at about 8¢ a photo. The model it replaced caught about half.

  • Agent tool calls leave durable receipts, so a session killed mid-deploy resumes without sending the same email or order twice.

  • Invoices extracted from supplier emails matched what a person had entered 66 times out of 66.

  • A constraint solver replans the whole factory every two minutes, across robots, ovens and people.

What we look for

  • You've put LLM agents into production and can tell us what broke and how you knew it was working.

  • You're a strong software engineer first. Most of this job is real engineering, not prompting: concurrency, idempotency, data modelling, security.

  • You build the eval before you trust the result.

  • You like the physical world: cameras, robots, parts rotated by 90°.

  • Bonus: computer vision, optimisation or electronics.

Stack

  • Agents: Claude Code, Codex, Claude and OpenAI APIs, MCP, skills in plain Markdown

  • Code: TypeScript (Bun, React), Python (FastAPI, Dagster, OpenCV, OR-Tools), PostgreSQL

  • Infra: Nix and NixOS, Nomad, Terraform, Vault, AWS, Modal sandboxes, OpenTelemetry

title: Mitarbeiter in der Kundenbetreuung (m,f,d)
description: Wir suchen eine empathische und kundenorientierte Person, für den Patient:innen Support unserer Kunden. Die Stelle ist zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet. Das Gehalt liegt zwischen 35.000-42.000€ Brutto im Jahr. Die Stelle kann auch Remote durchgeführt werden. Was dich in der Rolle als Mitarbeiter:in in der Kundenbetreuung erwartet Als Mitarbeiter:in in der Kundenbetreuung bist du die Stimme von Nelly für Patient:innen. Mit Empathie, Klarheit und einem guten Gespür für Bedürfnisse begleitest du sie durch aufkommende Fragen. Du sorgst dafür, dass sich die Patient:innen unsere Kund:innen jederzeit gut betreut fühlen. Über Nelly Wir sind ein Tech-Unternehmen und glauben, dass sich Gesundheitsversorgung deutlich weniger nach Papierkram anfühlen sollte und viel mehr nach Menschen. Deshalb entwickeln wir Technologie, mit der medizinische Praxen einfach, effizient und ohne administratives Chaos arbeiten können. Unsere Plattform verwandelt komplexe und zeitaufwendige Prozesse in intelligente, automatisierte Workflows – von der Patient Journey über Abrechnung bis hin zu modernen Zahlungslösungen. KI-gestützt, für echte Menschen gebaut und darauf ausgelegt, medizinischen Teams genau das zurückzugeben, was ihnen oft fehlt: Zeit und Fokus. Warum wir das tun? Europa steht vor einem massiven Mangel an medizinischen Fachangestellten. Wenn wir nicht grundlegend neu denken, wie Praxen arbeiten, wird das System langfristig nicht mehr funktionieren. Wir setzen deshalb nicht auf kurzfristige Lösungen, sondern auf echte, nachhaltige Veränderung. Mit 50 Mio. € Series-B-Finanzierung von führenden internationalen Investor:innen wachsen wir schnell – mit dem Ziel, Europas führendes Healthcare-Fintech aufzubauen. Unsere Vision: Über eine Million medizinische Praxen stärken und das Leben von Millionen Patient:innen spürbar verbessern. Und das Wichtigste zum Schluss: Wir arbeiten nur mit netten Menschen. Das ist unsere wichtigste Regel. Keine Egos, kein Drama, sondern neugierige, engagierte und empathische Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas Sinnvolles aufbauen wollen. Wenn sich das nach deinem Ort anfühlt: Willkommen bei Nelly. Deine Rolle bei uns: Du bist die Stimme von Nelly für Patient:innen, die Nelly nutzen und unterstützt sie mit Empathie, Geduld und einem ausgeprägten Sinn für Details bei allen aufkommendFragen Du kommunizierst auf Augenhöhe und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen sich jederzeit gut begleitet fühlen. Du denkst mit und weiter: Kundenfeedback und Verbesserungspotenziale erkennst du frühzeitig und leitest sie gezielt an unser Product Team weiter, um unsere Lösungen stetig besser zu machen. Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleg:innen aus verschiedenen Teams zusammen, insbesondere mit dem Customer Success, Sales und Product Team, denn wir glauben an echte Collaboration über Abteilungen hinweg. Das bringst du mit: Du bist motiviert und hast Spaß daran mit Kunden in Kontakt zu kommen und diese zu betreuen Du bist zuverlässig und kannst mit deiner strukturierten Arbeitsweise selbstständig arbeiten Du bist kommunikativ stark und trittst selbstsicher in Kundengesprächen auf Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau Unsere Benefits: Talent Density. Du arbeitest Seite an Seite mit den klügsten Köpfen, die wir finden konnten: an schwierigen Problemen, als Team. Wir stellen uns Herausforderungen gemeinsam und vergessen dabei nie, Spaß zu haben. Sehr starke Wachstumskurve. Neue Herausforderungen, mehr Verantwortung und echte Ownership vom ersten Tag an. Wir vertrauen darauf, dass du Dinge selbst in die Hand nimmst und dich zu Wort meldest, wenn etwas nicht stimmt. Nur Stillstand solltest du nicht erwarten. Ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget , dazu Coaching, Feedback und internes Wissen, das dich wirklich weiterbringt. Wir investieren in deine Entwicklung. Du gestaltest von Anfang an mit, wie wir etwas Großes aufbauen. Wir bauen das finanzielle Betriebssystem für das europäische Gesundheitswesen. KI ist dabei fester Bestandteil davon, wie wir arbeiten. Deutschlandticket oder Swapfiets-Mitgliedschaft. Urban-Sports-Club-Mitgliedschaft. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell und bis zu 4 Wochen Workation. Ein hundefreundliches Büro. Wir leben Vielfalt und freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Geschlechter (m/w/d). Und weil wir wissen, dass Selbstzweifel oder das sogenannte Impostor-Syndrom oft davon abhalten, sich zu bewerben, gilt: Zögere nicht, auch wenn du nicht jedes einzelne Kriterium erfüllst. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.


Overview

The purpose of the Research Manager role is to ensure Knit customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their partnerships with Knit. By owning and supporting customer relationships, getting deeply engrained in customer research needs, and driving high-quality project deliverables, the Research Manager’s impact is ultimately measured by positive customer retention.

Responsibilities:

The research function is a primary contributor to Knit’s shared business objectives of customer retention and upsells, ultimately measured by Net Revenue Retention (NRR) in addition to supporting successful Pilot to Subscription Conversions for acquiring new business.

The levers the Research Manager role owns to influence these key business objectives are:

  • Research Success → Ensuring Knit Customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their projects with Knit, measured by successfully achieving Research Objectives and delivering on Knit’s Quality & Speed service-level agreements (SLA’s)

Primary responsibilities of this role:

  • Serving as the dedicated research lead for all customers’ projects (on assigned accounts) and serving as the ultimate accountable part for research project success

  • Driving and documenting in-depth project scoping to uncover a deep understanding of research objectives and project context to set up project success

  • Demonstrate a growth mindset as a solutions architect for customers, educating them on Knit’s research capabilities, consulting with them to adjust for fringe requirements, and proposing solutions to maximize project success - escalating to Research Directors when needs exceed capabilities

  • Escalating needs to Research Directors to support troubleshooting when increased risk for project viability or customer impact occurs

  • Driving, maintaining, and enriching all customer context to improve Knit’s ability to meet the customers’ custom research needs

  • Being the final, customer-ready check and approver on all Knit final topline delivery and presenting the key insights and recommendations directly to the customers

  • Participating in continuous innovation on Knit’s AI product to minimize the delta between Knit’s AI output and a human researcher output

  • Driving on feedback collection on “the last mile” - uncovering and documenting what happens after Knit delivers a project to when it’s “stakeholder ready,” supporting Knit’s product vision in getting to stakeholder ready reports

Required Skills & Experiences:

  • Must have 5+ years of market research experience, with the majority of the time spent on the supplier side in a market research agency environment.

  • Must have experience leading discovery and scoping calls, writing and editing quant and qual questionnaires from scratch, drafting analysis plans, and creating and presenting stakeholder-ready insights topline & reports.

  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes in ambiguous environments, both for navigating complex customer needs and Knit internal business changes. Proven track record successfully operating in an early stage startup (<50 employees) is a plus.

  • Proven track record of owning and supporting client relationships with customers at Enterprise, Fortune 500 US-based companies, specifically working with insights professionals to scope and achieve desired research outcomes, resulting in customer retention and growth.

  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes successfully in environments with competing priorities, multiple research projects on at a given time, and simultaneous internal business demands.

Benefits

Upon joining the Knit team, you will receive a competitive salary + commission plan if applicable to role, Equity Options, Healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), and Additional Coverage, a company laptop and one-time, onboarding Technology Stipend, a 401(k) with company match, flexible time-off, hybrid working, and more!

Salary

In accordance with New York pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role is $115,000 - $130,000. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s level, experience, and qualifications upon joining Knit.

Our Company Values

We are the Championship Team. This means we:

  • Are 1% better every day: We approach situations with a growth mindset and ask, “How can we make the business better?” and “What would it take?”

  • Play to win: We set audacious goals and push ourselves to achieve them with a bias towards action (When we see a need, we take initiative, and hold ourselves accountable to seeing it through).

  • Keep the main thing the main thing: Identify what has the biggest impact and prioritize to focus on it.

Provide technical leadership to the development team through code reviews, mentoring, release governance, documentation, and deployment readiness activities. Requirements Several years of hands-on software development experience on SAP BTP, ideally within Clean Core transformation projects. Proven expertise with RAP and/or CAP and the development of enterprise-grade cloud applications. Strong knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security concepts on SAP BTP, including XSUAA and role-based access management. Practical experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions, Agentic AI concepts, and Human-in-the-Loop implementation approaches. Demonstrated ability to take ownership of architecture and solution design, while leading delivery within agile development teams. Nice to have Deep expertise in AI-enabled solutions and services on SAP BTP. Experience with SAP RISE, SAP BTP Integration Suite, and API management capabilities. Previous experience leading small development teams within banking, public funding, or regulated financial environments. German language skills. Benefits You will have the opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry on an incredibly ambitious project to shape the ever-evolving financial sector. This is an environment where you can have it all — the agility, enthusiasm, and dynamism of a start-up, combined with the established expertise, solid market presence, and extensive customer network of a more established organization. As an employee, you can chart your career path and take advantage of competitive compensation packages and progression opportunities based on merit. CoreWeaveProvide guidance on international tax topics&nbsp;</li> </ul> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>ACA, CA, CTA, ACCA or comparable corporate tax and accounting knowledge&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>10+ years of progressive corporate tax experience in public accounting and multinational companies.</li> <li>Solid technical tax knowledge across EMEA and APAC.</li> <li>Experience in managing global projects</li> <li>Strong leadership, analytical, and communication skills with executive presence.</li> <ul> <li>Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities</li> <li>Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills</li> </ul> <li>Interest in building with new technology and automation</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit?</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. You will shape the roadmap across data processing, distributed training, simulation and validation, working alongside product, research, engineering and commercial stakeholders.</p> <p>This hands-on technical leadership role spans the full stack, from bare-metal GPU/CPU topologies, networking and storage through workload orchestration to application-facing APIs and autonomous driving software ecosystems, including NVIDIA's. You will define how fleet data, sensor simulation, synthetic data generation and closed-loop evaluation fit together into reproducible workflows, balancing simulation fidelity, throughput, reliability and cost.</p> <p>You will partner directly with automotive manufacturers, suppliers and autonomous vehicle developers to understand their requirements, identify capability gaps and translate platform capabilities into deployed solutions. You will guide strategic customer engagements, establish reference architectures and help turn technical advances into customer adoption and commercial growth.</p> <p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven track record of founding, leading or architecting autonomous vehicle platforms, simulation systems or AI infrastructure that reached production or commercial deployment.</li> <li>Deep understanding of autonomous driving workflows, including perception, prediction and planning, and how data, model training, simulation and evaluation support their development.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building distributed systems under demanding throughput, latency, reliability and scale requirements.</li> <li>Experience designing GPU-based training or simulation platforms, with a strong understanding of compute, networking, storage and workload orchestration.</li> <li>Familiarity with fleet data pipelines, sensor simulation, scenario generation and closed-loop testing, including reproducibility and coverage of rare or difficult driving conditions.</li> <li>Ability to identify where existing architectures limit customer outcomes, define practical alternatives and build alignment across engineering, research and product teams.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to connect system architecture with product strategy and business development, working directly with technical leaders and enterprise customers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you're a good fit?</strong></p> <p>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.</p> <ul> <li>You love taking complex autonomy and AI infrastructure challenges from initial architectural design through to commercially successful deployment.</li> <li>You're curious about how advances in simulation, synthetic data and AI models can accelerate the development and validation of autonomous vehicles.</li> <li>You enjoy working directly with customers and bringing engineering, research and commercial teams together around a clear technical direction.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></p> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be Curious at Your Core</li> <li>Act Like an Owner</li> <li>Empower Employees</li> <li>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</li> <li>Achieve More Together</li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organisation's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p><em>The base salary range for this role is £146,000 to £195,000. The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance&nbsp;</li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution&nbsp;</li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Critical Illness Cover&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme&nbsp;</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms &amp; Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.</em></em></span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.</em></span></em></p> <p><strong>Export Control Compliance</strong></p> <p>This position requires access to export controlled information. &nbsp;To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. &nbsp;CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><em>Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications&nbsp;</em></strong></p> <p><em>When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by CoreWeave UK Ltd.
