title: Director of MSSP Sales, EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.</p> <p>Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.&nbsp;</p></div><p>The Director, MSSP Sales, EMEA will architect, build, and scale ExtraHop’s dedicated MSSP and MDR business across EMEA. As ExtraHop continues to dominate the Network Detection and Response (NDR) space, this leader will transform how managed service providers leverage the Reveal(x) platform to deliver high-fidelity threat detection and response to their end customers. You will own the entire lifecycle of the MSSP relationship: from strategic partner acquisition and commercial modeling to technical enablement and co-selling execution</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong><br><strong>Strategy &amp; Commercial Modeling:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Define the Go-To-Market (GTM): </strong>Design and execute a comprehensive EMEA strategy specifically targeting top-tier MSSPs and MDR providers.</li> <li><strong>Structure MSSP Frameworks: </strong>Collaborate with Finance, Product, and Operations to design scalable, competitive commercial models (e.g., consumption-based pricing, multi-tenant licensing, pay-as-you-grow, and subscription models).</li> <li><strong>Value Proposition: </strong>Refine ExtraHop's messaging to clearly articulate how our platform reduces MSSP analyst burnout, lowers mean time to resolution (MTTR), and increases partner margins.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Partner Acquisition &amp; Revenue Generation: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Pipeline Ownership: </strong>Directly hunt and secure predictable, recurring revenue streams by embedding ExtraHop Reveal(x) into the core tech stacks of major MSSPs</li> <li><strong>Co-Sell &amp; Sell-Through: </strong>Drive both "sell-to" (the MSSP's own infrastructure) and "sell-through/with" (leveraging the MSSP's sales force to pull ExtraHop into enterprise accounts) revenue streams.</li> <li><strong>Executive Relationships: </strong>Build deep, trust-based relationships with C-level executives (CEOs, CISOs, CTOs) within the target MSSP ecosystem.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership &amp; Enablement: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Team Building:&nbsp;</strong>Act as a player-coach initially, with the mandate to recruit, hire, and lead a high-performing team of MSSP Account Managers and Channel Solutions Architects as the business scales.</li> <li><strong>Enablement Ecosystem:&nbsp;</strong>Partner with ExtraHop Technical Marketing and Sales Enablement to build specialized onboarding, technical training, and co-marketing (MDF) programs tailored for MSSPs.</li> <li><strong>Product Feedback Loop:&nbsp;</strong>Act as the voice of the MSSP partner internally, providing feedback to Product Management regarding multi-tenancy, API integrations, and reporting capabilities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications</strong><br>● &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;10+ Years in Cybersecurity Sales: A proven track record of selling enterprise-grade security software (preferably NDR, EDR, SIEM, or XDR).<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;5+ Years of Dedicated MSSP/MDR Leadership: Direct experience owning, scaling, and structuring deals with major MSSPs (e.g., Optiv, Secureworks, Verizon, Deloitte, Expel).<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Proven "Zero-to-One" Success: Experience building a new route-to-market, division, or partner program from scratch within an established tech company.<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Complex Commercial Structuring: Deep familiarity with usage-based, multi-tenant, and utility pricing models.</p> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong><br>● &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;High Technical Acumen: Ability to speak authoritatively with MSSP SOC Directors and CTOs about architecture, APIs, and integration ecosystems.<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Strong Operational Discipline: Ability to accurately forecast revenue based on a partner led managed service sales motion rather than direct to customer sales motion.<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Gravitas &amp; Influence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to navigate complex, multi-party enterprise deal cycles.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ABOUT EXTRAHOP</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.</p> <p>This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.</p> <p><strong>OUR VALUES</strong></p> <p>Our culture is rooted in our five <strong>Values</strong>. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Lead with Purpose:</strong> We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.</p> <p><strong>Act with Integrity:</strong> We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Find a Way:</strong> We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.</p> <p><strong>Innovate: </strong>We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.</p> <p><strong>Share Success:</strong> We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>BENEFITS</strong></p> <p><strong>Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team.</strong> Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:</p> <ul> <li>Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits</li> <li>Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time</li> <li>Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan</li> <li>FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable</li> <li>Educational Reimbursement</li> <li>401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable</li> <li>Pet Insurance (US Only)</li> <li>Parental Leave (US Only)</li> <li>Hybrid and Remote Work Model</li> </ul> <p>Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today! &nbsp;</p> <p><strong>To learn more, visit&nbsp;</strong><a href="https://www.extrahop.com/"><strong>our website</strong></a><strong> or follow us on </strong><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/extrahop-networks/"><strong>LinkedIn</strong></a><strong>.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Create a Job Alert</strong></p> <p>Interested in building your career at ExtraHop? Get future opportunities sent straight to your email.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Workforce Intelligence & Analytics Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.&nbsp;</strong><br><strong>&nbsp;</strong><br><strong>We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.</strong><br><strong>&nbsp;</strong><br><strong>Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.&nbsp;</strong><br><strong>&nbsp;</strong><br><strong>For more information, visit <a href="https://eur02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwpp.com%2F&amp;data=05%7C02%7CErica.Durr%40wpp.com%7C9bf4566a65bc46a48ac008de749116ea%7C150b5e663d884dee83f6ed149b727a00%7C0%7C0%7C639076363668176216%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=Q9juosud56XGLThSFZ1NpPZd6FXpJPxV74OeRZWoh%2B4%3D&amp;reserved=0" target="_blank">WPP.com.</a></strong><br><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p></div><h1>About WPP</h1> <p>WPP is the creative transformation company. Through One WPP and the Elevate28 transformation agenda, we are building a simpler, more integrated, agile and AI-powered enterprise. WPP’s Performance &amp; Culture Center of Excellence brings together the capabilities that help our people, teams and organisation perform, grow and thrive. Within it, Enterprise Effectiveness aligns WPP’s organisation, workforce and teams around its strategic priorities and enables the change required to deliver them.</p> <h1>About the Role</h1> <p>The Workforce Intelligence &amp; Analytics Manager is a contract role that will build the evidence base for the workforce and organisation decisions that matter most to WPP. This role will turn fragmented people, organisation and business data into clear insight, forward-looking scenarios and practical recommendations that help leaders decide where to invest, how to shape the workforce and how to organise for performance.</p> <p>Reporting to the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, you will support the wider Performance &amp; Culture Center of Excellence while working closely with business, People &amp; Culture, Finance, Data and Technology partners. You will establish a trusted workforce-intelligence capability that supports strategic workforce planning and informs priority organisation, workforce, team and people decisions across Enterprise Effectiveness and the wider Performance &amp; Culture Center of Excellence. This is not a traditional reporting role. It combines strategic analytics, internal consulting and leadership of a four-person data and reporting team based in India. You will be expected to work through ambiguity, connect disparate data and systems, and progressively turn fragmented analytics into a more integrated, trusted and usable capability. As a contract appointment, the initial focus will be to establish the core workforce-intelligence approach, strengthen the India-based team and deliver insight against WPP’s highest-priority workforce and organisation questions.</p> <h1>Why This Role Matters</h1> <p>WPP’s transformation requires faster, better choices about work, skills, capacity, organisation and investment. Those choices cannot be made from disconnected dashboards or backward-looking metrics alone. In this role, you will create a more integrated view of the workforce, translate evidence into choices and trade-offs, and help leaders anticipate the implications of AI, changing client demand and new ways of working. The work will directly shape how WPP builds the capabilities, capacity and organisation required for Elevate28.</p> <h1>What You’ll Do</h1> <h2>Build a trusted workforce intelligence capability</h2> <ul> <li>Working with the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, shape and build an enterprise workforce-intelligence approach that connects people, organisation and business data to the decisions leaders need to make.</li> <li>Define a focused set of workforce and organisational measures, dashboards and decision-support tools, moving reporting from activity and headcount toward capacity, capability, cost, productivity, risk and value.</li> <li>Partner with data owners and technology teams to map fragmented data and systems, define analytical requirements, and strengthen data definitions, quality, accessibility and responsible use, while being clear about limitations and the strength of the evidence.</li> <li>Establish repeatable analytical standards, governance and quality controls so insight is trusted, comparable and usable across WPP.</li> <li>Apply AI and automation to improve how workforce data is integrated, analysed and translated into decision support, while maintaining appropriate human judgement, transparency and responsible-use standards.</li> </ul> <h2>Enable strategic workforce planning</h2> <ul> <li>Help business and People &amp; Culture leaders translate strategy, growth priorities and choices about how work is organised into workforce demand, capability and capacity requirements.</li> <li>Build scenarios that show the implications of different choices, including developing, hiring, accessing external capability, automating, augmenting, redeploying and exiting work or roles.</li> <li>Assess the current workforce and future talent supply, including critical skills, capacity, cost, location and role mix, highlighting gaps, risks and investment priorities.</li> <li>Connect workforce planning to business and financial planning cycles so decisions are timely, owned and grounded in common assumptions.</li> </ul> <h2>Deliver forward-looking insight and decision support</h2> <ul> <li>Use statistical analysis, forecasting and scenario modelling to identify emerging workforce and organisational risks, opportunities and patterns.</li> <li>Bring structure to ambiguous business questions, identify what can be answered with available data, test hypotheses and distinguish meaningful signals from correlation or noise.</li> <li>Turn analysis into clear choices, trade-offs and recommendations for senior leaders, including the consequences of action and inaction.</li> <li>Develop concise executive narratives and visualisations that make complex findings understandable without oversimplifying them.</li> </ul> <h2>Strengthen organisation and transformation decisions</h2> <ul> <li>Provide analytical support for organisation design, organisational health, inclusion and impact, talent development, team effectiveness and change priorities across Performance and Culture.</li> <li>Create baselines and evaluate whether organisation and workforce interventions are improving the intended outcomes.</li> <li>Combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight to explain not only what is happening, but why it matters and where targeted action is needed.</li> <li>Identify enterprise patterns across businesses, markets and functions and convert them into practical recommendations for leaders and Enterprise Effectiveness partners.</li> </ul> <h2>Scale tools, capability and adoption</h2> <ul> <li>Build practical tools, templates and self-service products that improve the quality and consistency of workforce decisions.</li> <li>Coach People &amp; Culture and business partners to interpret workforce insight, challenge assumptions and use scenarios in decision-making.</li> <li>Create a clear intake and prioritisation approach that focuses analytical capacity on the highest-value enterprise questions.</li> <li>Continuously improve the offer through user feedback, adoption evidence and emerging practice in workforce analytics, AI and organisational science.</li> <li>Lead and develop a four-person data and reporting team based in India, setting clear priorities, strengthening analytical and consulting capability, and shifting delivery from fragmented reporting toward higher-value workforce intelligence and decision support.</li> </ul> <h1>Minimum Qualifications</h1> <ul> <li>Relevant experience applying data and analytics in finance, commercial, operational or other business settings, together with experience in people analytics, workforce intelligence or strategic workforce planning.</li> <li>Experience translating business questions into analytical approaches, workforce scenarios and decision-ready recommendations.</li> <li>Strong capability in data analysis, forecasting, modelling and visualisation, using appropriate business intelligence or analytical tools.</li> <li>Proven experience working through ambiguity and improving a fragmented data and analytics environment by connecting disparate sources and systems, strengthening definitions and quality, and establishing practical governance, privacy and ethical standards.</li> <li>Ability to communicate complex findings clearly and influence senior stakeholders in a complex organisation.</li> <li>AI fluency, including a practical understanding of how AI and automation can improve analytics, workforce planning and decision support, and how they may reshape work, skills, roles and workforce requirements.</li> <li>Experience leading and developing an analytics or reporting team, including setting priorities, assuring quality and building capability across locations.</li> <li>A degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <h1>Preferred Experience</h1> <ul> <li>Experience applying financial, commercial or operational analysis to workforce investment, capacity, productivity or organisation decisions.</li> <li>Experience in a complex global, matrixed or multi-business organisation, ideally supporting enterprise transformation or significant workforce change.</li> <li>Proficiency with relevant business intelligence, data-visualisation or analytical tools, which may include Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python or R.</li> <li>Postgraduate study or relevant professional qualifications in analytics, finance, strategic workforce planning or a related field.</li> </ul> <h1>What Success Looks Like</h1> <ul> <li>A clear enterprise workforce-intelligence proposition focused on the workforce and organisation decisions most critical to One WPP and Elevate28.</li> <li>A more integrated and trusted data foundation, with common definitions, practical governance and decision-support tools that connect workforce, organisation, business and financial insight.</li> <li>Workforce plans, scenarios and recommendations that materially improve decisions about skills, capacity, location, cost, AI and automation, technology and workforce shape.</li> <li>Stronger adoption of workforce insight by business and People &amp; Culture leaders, with greater confidence in what the data can and cannot support.</li> <li>A focused, capable India-based team that delivers consistent reporting while building higher-value workforce intelligence and decision-support capability.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</strong></p> <p><strong>WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</strong></p> <h4><strong>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment">https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment</a>) for more information on how we process the information you provide.</strong></h4></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Software Engineer (ML QA)
description: <h2>About the job</h2> <p>Build the software that validates Graphcore’s machine learning stack, from frameworks to AI accelerator hardware.</p> <p>You’ll design production-quality test infrastructure that engineers can extend, maintain and rely on as Graphcore’s ML software grows. Your work will help teams deliver reliable products, with clear evidence of numerical accuracy and performance across the stack.</p> <p>You’ll architect scalable test frameworks and build CI/CD pipelines that run across simulators, emulators and physical hardware. You’ll create representative ML workloads, analyse their execution and turn the results into practical improvements to testing and tooling.</p> <p>This role gives you scope to shape software architecture and developer experience, not just add tests to existing systems. You’ll deepen your understanding of the AI compute stack while solving engineering problems that connect software design with hardware behaviour.</p> <h2>The team and culture</h2> <p>Graphcore’s ML QA engineers build automation, work with industry-standard frameworks and models, and contribute to upstream open-source projects. You’ll work across software teams, using code and design reviews to strengthen quality, security and maintainability.</p> <p>You’ll use workload results to challenge assumptions and guide technical decisions about how Graphcore tests its ML stack. You’ll own improvements, act quickly on testing gaps and mentor junior engineers to raise the team’s technical standards.</p> <h2>What we’re looking for</h2> <ul> <li>Strong Python skills, demonstrated through designing, developing and maintaining production-quality software.</li> <li>Software design and architecture skills for large, complex codebases, with a focus on testability and long-term maintainability.</li> <li>Experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated testing systems in Linux environments.</li> <li>Familiarity with C or C++, including the ability to read, debug and reason about low-level code.</li> <li>The ability to mentor junior engineers and influence engineering practices through constructive feedback.</li> <li>A self-directed approach to solving complex problems, identifying gaps and driving improvements.</li> </ul> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.</p> <h2>Benefits</h2> <p>· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <h2>Sponsorship</h2> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.</p> <h2>Join the Team at Graphcore</h2> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p>Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.</p> <p>Ready to shape how Graphcore tests its ML software stack? Apply now to join our ML QA team.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>Location:</strong> Bristol, UK<br><strong>Salary: </strong>£2500 per month<br><strong>Start date: </strong>June 2027<br><strong>Application deadline</strong>: Midnight, 29th November 2026&nbsp;<br><em>We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline.</em></p> <h3>The Internship Programme at Graphcore</h3> <p>Explore a career at Graphcore through a 12-week summer internship, gaining hands-on experience on real projects. You’ll bring fresh ideas, put your learning into practice and help shape what we’re creating. Along the way, you’ll tackle challenging problems with a team who welcome your questions and support you as you build your skills and confidence.</p> <h3>What you’ll work on</h3> <p>Use your programming skills and curiosity to help AI models run efficiently on next-generation Graphcore hardware.&nbsp;</p> <p>In AI Compute Libraries &amp; Performance, you’ll contribute to C++ libraries and compute kernels for machine learning workloads. Your work will include:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Developing compute kernels:</strong> Implement and improve operations such as matrix multiplication (GEMM), convolutions, reductions, elementwise operations and fused kernels that combine multiple operations.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Understanding and improving performance:</strong> Use profiling and microbenchmarks to measure execution speed and investigate how threading, cache locality, memory layout and kernel launch efficiency affect performance.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Checking correctness and reliability:</strong> Build regression tests and numerical checks, investigate issues and improve the quality of the libraries our customers use.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Through these projects, you’ll develop practical experience connecting numerical computing with how code runs on hardware, helping deliver software that is fast, accurate and reliable.&nbsp;</p> <h3>Your team and support</h3> <p>You’ll join a team building high-performance compute libraries that help customers get more from Graphcore hardware. title: Senior Software Engineer (ML QA)
description: <h2>About the job</h2> <p>Build the software that validates Graphcore’s machine learning stack, from frameworks to AI accelerator hardware.</p> <p>You’ll design production-quality test infrastructure that engineers can extend, maintain and rely on as Graphcore’s ML software grows. Your work will help teams deliver reliable products, with clear evidence of numerical accuracy and performance across the stack.&nbsp;You’ll architect scalable test frameworks and build CI/CD pipelines that run across simulators, emulators and physical hardware. You’ll create representative ML workloads, analyse their execution and turn the results into practical improvements to testing and tooling.</p> <p>This role gives you scope to shape software architecture and developer experience, not just add tests to existing systems. You’ll deepen your understanding of the AI compute stack while solving engineering problems that connect software design with hardware behaviour.</p> <h2>The team and culture</h2> <p>Graphcore’s ML QA engineers build automation, work with industry-standard frameworks and models, and contribute to upstream open-source projects. You’ll work across software teams, using code and design reviews to strengthen quality, security and maintainability.</p> <p>You’ll use workload results to challenge assumptions and guide technical decisions about how Graphcore tests its ML stack. You’ll own improvements, act quickly on testing gaps and mentor junior engineers to raise the team’s technical standards.</p> <h2>What we’re looking for</h2> <ul> <li>Strong Python skills, demonstrated through designing, developing and maintaining production-quality software.</li> <li>Software design and architecture skills for large, complex codebases, with a focus on testability and long-term maintainability.</li> <li>Experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated testing systems in Linux environments.</li> <li>Familiarity with C or C++, including the ability to read, debug and reason about low-level code.</li> <li>The ability to mentor junior engineers and influence engineering practices through constructive feedback.</li> <li>A self-directed approach to solving complex problems, identifying gaps and driving improvements.</li> </ul> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.</p> <h2>Benefits</h2> <p>· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <h2>Sponsorship</h2> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.</p> <h2>Join the Team at Graphcore</h2> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p>Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.</p> <p>Ready to shape how Graphcore tests its ML software stack? Apply now to join our ML QA team.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Mobile Developer - L5
description: 📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH) | 💰 £75,000 Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology. Our products, Street.co.uk and Spectre form a powerful duo, working harmoniously together to transform an agent's job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK. How we work in 2026 Engineering at Street Group has changed. Most of us don't write code by hand day-to-day anymore - agents do; we direct. For our mobile team, that shifts where the value is: when AI handles more of the code, what matters most is how the app looks, how it feels, what it does for the user and the ideas you bring to it. Understanding the product and the people using it sits at the heart of the role: we expect engineers to know why they're building something, not just how. Being genuinely tuned into AI tooling is core to the role here, not a side skill and if you'd rather not work this way, that's fair but we're probably not the place for you. Equally, if you see mobile engineering as getting code onto a screen and calling it "good enough", this probably isn't the role for you either. We're a small, autonomous mobile team working on what we think is the best PropTech app on the market. There's no micromanagement and no fixed sprint rituals: when a new project kicks off we get together as a "three amigos" with product and design, get the first tickets out, then keep the conversation going as the work develops. You'll have dedicated backend, design and product colleagues alongside you, and full freedom over how you work. If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a growing company, we think you'd fit right in! Here's what you can expect to be working on as a Mobile Developer (L5) at Street Group Owning the end-to-end delivery of significant features in our React Native app: scoping the problem, directing the build, testing, shipping and iterating based on what you learn. Directing agent sessions to deliver work, while your own attention goes on the user experience, platform feel and the decisions where your judgement is required. Making every experience feel natural on both iOS and Android - understanding what users on each platform expect, and building for it. Looking after the live app: monitoring, stability and our weekly releases across the App Store and Google Play. Defining what success looks like before you build, analysing how features perform after release, and proactively bringing the results - good or bad, backed by data - to product and design. Being a regular voice in product discussions: taking a loose "what if we..." idea and turning it into a strong first version. Picking up tech debt and spotting improvements alongside your main feature, keeping the app maintainable and extendable. Helping to shape new mobile work as it expands across more of the business, including consumer monetisation and lettings. A bit about you You have commercial experience building and shipping production apps with React Native and TypeScript, on both iOS and Android. You work AI-natively as a default, using tools like Claude Code fluently - and you understand what the AI produces well enough to explain and own it. If your current employer doesn't allow AI tools, we'd expect you've been exploring them in your own time. You have strong product and design sense: you're user-focused and care about how something feels to use, not just whether it works. You take quality seriously - your work is tested, solid and thought through before it ships. You've looked after a live app and see its stability, monitoring and releases as part of your job. title: Member of Scientific Staff, Cell Culture and Functional Assays
description: LOCATION: King's Cross, London · PATTERN: Lab-based, full-time The opportunity We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders. This role covers the cell side of our protein characterisation work. You would keep the cell lines healthy and run the assays that show how a designed protein behaves on a living cell, week after week, to the same standard. About us AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one. We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team. The role You will run cell culture and the cell-based assays for our protein characterisation work. That means the mammalian lines the assays depend on, from thaw through routine passage to a banked and documented stock, and the weekly rhythm of seeding, treating, reading and reporting plates. Most of it runs in 384-well plates with imaging-based or flow cytometry readouts. You will run those assays as designed, with the controls and replicates that make a curve defensible, and you will be the person who notices when a plate, a line or a reagent lot has started to drift. Assay design and the shape of the cascade sit with the scientist who leads this work today, so you are not being asked to invent the panel. You are being asked to make it run the same way every week, to record what you did in a form the rest of the system can read, and to tighten the protocols as they settle, including moving them towards the plate formats our automation will take on. Your first 90 days FIRST 30 DAYS ◆ Take over routine culture and banking for the protein cell lines, working to the protocols we already run. ◆ Learn the panel end to end by running each assay alongside the scientist who owns it. DAYS 30 TO 60 ◆ Run at least one assay in the panel independently, including its controls and acceptance criteria. ◆ Revise one culture or assay protocol so that someone else could follow it without asking you. DAYS 60 TO 90 ◆ Hold the weekly assay schedule on your own and return results on the agreed turnaround. ◆ Bring one protocol to a tighter precision bar, or into a plate format ready for automation. Who you are You are a hands-on cell biologist who takes assay variability personally. You have run the same assay often enough to tell a real effect from a bad plate, and you would rather find the cause than repeat the run. The week has a rhythm in this job: cells to feed, plates to seed, runs to finish, numbers to return. You are happy with that, you keep records someone else can pick up, and you say early when something looks wrong rather than at the end of the week. We do not hire people into boxes. The team is small, and early hires here end up owning work beyond the job they joined for. Nobody arrives with every part of this role. ◆ Learn the panel end to end by running each assay alongside the scientist who owns it.

DAYS 30 TO 60

◆ Run at least one assay in the panel independently, including its controls and acceptance criteria.

◆ Revise one culture or assay protocol so that someone else could follow it without asking you.

DAYS 60 TO 90

◆ Hold the weekly assay schedule on your own and return results on the agreed turnaround.

◆ Bring one protocol to a tighter precision bar, or into a plate format ready for automation.

Who you are

◆ Comfort with plate-based work and the arithmetic that goes with it, such as dilution series, plate maps and normalisation.

◆ Careful, traceable record-keeping that someone else can follow without asking you.

◆ Reporter cell line bioassays for binding or blockade.

◆ Receptor internalisation, lysosomal trafficking or cytotoxicity assays.

◆ High-content or fluorescence imaging, and the image analysis behind it.

◆ 384-well formats, liquid handlers or other plate-based automation.

◆ Flow cytometry, for example for surface receptor quantification.

That changes what good looks like. Precision matters more than novelty, a protocol is only finished when someone else can run it and get your answer, and every passage, plate and reagent lot is captured as structured data, because a result is only as trustworthy as the cells behind it.

Some people find that energising; some find it outside their lane. Worth knowing in advance which one you are.

How we work

Ingénieur Projet Pré-FEED (H/F)

Informations clés

  • Référence : 262403S

  • Démarrage : Janvier 2027

  • Durée : Mission longue durée

  • Type de contrat : Freelance ou CDIC

  • Zone géographique : Occitanie (81)

  • Langue : Anglais courant indispensable

Contexte de la mission

Dans le cadre d'un programme de construction d'une nouvelle usine industrielle à l'international, prévu sur la période 2028-2032, nous recherchons un profil expérimenté pour intervenir en phase amont d'analyse des besoins et de pré-FEED (Front-End Engineering Design).

La mission consiste à réaliser un audit approfondi de deux usines de production existantes, l'une en France et l'autre en Amérique du Nord, afin d'identifier les bonnes pratiques, les axes d'amélioration et les besoins des différents services.

L'objectif est de recueillir et de formaliser l'ensemble des exigences techniques, fonctionnelles et opérationnelles dans un cahier des charges aussi complet que possible, afin de sécuriser les futures phases d'ingénierie, de conception et de construction de la nouvelle usine.

Missions

  • Réaliser un audit fonctionnel et opérationnel de deux usines de production existantes, situées en France et en Amérique du Nord.

  • Analyser les installations, les méthodes de fonctionnement et les organisations en place afin d'identifier les bonnes pratiques, les points faibles et les axes d'amélioration.

  • Organiser et animer des groupes de travail avec l'ensemble des services concernés, notamment :

    • Maintenance

    • Exploitation et production

    • Process industriels

    • Traitement de l'air

  • Conduire des entretiens et des réunions de travail, notamment à distance via Teams, afin de faire émerger les besoins, contraintes et attentes de chaque service.

  • Challenger les interlocuteurs pour identifier les besoins explicites et implicites, anticiper les problématiques et garantir l'exhaustivité des exigences.

  • Recueillir, analyser et consolider les retours d'expérience des deux sites existants.

  • Identifier les exigences techniques, fonctionnelles, organisationnelles et opérationnelles à intégrer dans la conception de la future usine.

  • Définir les besoins d'industrialisation et les exigences relatives aux process de production.

  • Élaborer et structurer un cahier des charges (CDC) complet et détaillé, intégrant les besoins de l'ensemble des parties prenantes.

  • Rédiger les User Requirement Specifications (URS) afin de formaliser les exigences utilisateurs.

  • Participer à la phase de pré-FEED et contribuer à la définition des orientations techniques du futur site industriel.

  • Assurer la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des exigences afin de limiter les oublis, les modifications tardives et les risques lors des phases ultérieures du projet.

  • Faciliter les échanges entre les différents métiers et accompagner la convergence des besoins vers des spécifications communes.


  • Expérience senior de 10 ans minimum en ingénierie industrielle, conception d'usines de production ou gestion de projets industriels complexes.

  • Expérience significative et confirmée en phase de pré-FEED sur des projets internationaux de construction d'usines de production.

  • Expérience dans des environnements industriels de process, idéalement dans les secteurs de la chimie, de la cosmétique, de l'agroalimentaire ou d'industries de transformation similaires.

  • Solide expérience en audit d'installations industrielles existantes, analyse fonctionnelle et identification des besoins opérationnels.

  • Maîtrise de la rédaction de cahiers des charges techniques et des User Requirement Specifications (URS).

  • Bonne compréhension des enjeux industriels liés aux process, à la maintenance, à l'exploitation, à la production et aux utilités, notamment au traitement de l'air.

  • Capacité à analyser des organisations et installations existantes pour en tirer des recommandations applicables à une construction neuve.

  • Excellentes compétences en animation d'ateliers et en coordination de groupes de travail pluridisciplinaires.

  • Charisme, leadership et forte capacité à faire parler les différents interlocuteurs, y compris sur des besoins non formalisés.

  • Capacité à poser les bonnes questions, challenger les pratiques existantes et faire émerger les attentes de chaque métier.

  • Excellentes capacités d'écoute, d'analyse, de synthèse et de formalisation des exigences.

  • Vision globale des projets industriels et capacité à anticiper les impacts des choix réalisés en phase amont sur les étapes de conception et de construction.

  • Autonomie, rigueur, diplomatie et capacité à fédérer des interlocuteurs aux enjeux parfois divergents.

  • Expérience des environnements multiculturels et des projets industriels internationaux.

  • Anglais professionnel indispensable pour conduire des échanges techniques avec les équipes internationales.

raw.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
raw.description:
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global platform for desirable pre-loved fashion and a pioneer in transforming how people consume fashion.
 
Our mission is simple: make circular fashion the norm, not the exception.
Through technology, expertise, and a highly engaged global community, we enable millions of people to buy and sell fashion in a more sustainable way.
 
Founded in Paris in 2009, Vestiaire Collective is now a globally scaled marketplace with offices in Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, and Ho Chi Minh City, and logistics hubs across Europe, Asia, and the US.
Today, we are a team of around 600 people from over 50 nationalities, united by a shared ambition: to drive meaningful change in the fashion industry.
 
Our values, Activism, Transparency, Dedication, Greatness, and Collective, shape how we build, collaborate, and grow every day.

About the role : 

As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you will play a key role in our data ecosystem by modelling raw datasets into clear, reliable, and scalable data products that power strategic decision-making across the business.

Embedded within the central Analytics Engineering team, you will own and evolve data pipelines and analytical data products that support teams across Product, Marketing, CRM, Finance, Operations, and other areas of the business.

Beyond core development, you will drive data reliability, elevate our technical standards, and experiment with AI-assisted tools to streamline modern data workflows.

 

What you will do: 

• Design, build, and maintain scalable, high-performance data pipelines and reusable analytical data products using dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow.

• Transform complex raw data into structured, reliable, and accessible data models, supported by appropriate testing and documentation, that enable decision-making across the organisation.

• Own analytical data products throughout their lifecycle, from initial design and delivery through continuous improvement, evolution, and retirement, while considering performance, maintainability, and cost.

• Contribute to the evolution of the engineering foundations supporting Analytics Engineering, including CI/CD, orchestration, monitoring, deployment, and tooling version upgrades, in collaboration with Data Platform Engineering.

• Partner with Finance, Operations, Commercial, Marketing, CRM, Product, and other teams to translate business needs into clear, reliable, and scalable data solutions, applying technical judgement to clarify requirements and recommend effective approaches.

• Take ownership of projects from design through delivery and communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly.

• Explore and apply AI-assisted engineering tools across the data development lifecycle, including ingestion, transformation, testing, documentation, and deployment.

• Help define and embed Analytics Engineering best practices, fostering a culture of quality, ownership, documentation, testing, and continuous improvement across the team.

 

Who you are : 

• 3-5 years of relevant experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, BI Engineering, or a similar role, with hands-on experience designing, deploying, and maintaining large-scale, efficient ETL, ELT, or reverse ETL pipelines.

• Strong SQL and data transformation skills(DBT), including complex transformations and modular, reusable data models.

• Experience with Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, or another modern data warehouse, with awareness of performance and cost considerations.

• Experience with Airflow or a comparable tool for job orchestration, scheduling, and dependency management.

• Experience using Python for data processing, workflow automation, or developing data tooling.

• Experience with version controlling (GitHub), CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and observability.

• Ability to work autonomously, manage dependencies, and take accountability for data products and technical initiatives beyond their initial delivery.

• Ability to make and clearly communicate technical decisions and trade-offs.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Practical experience or strong interest in applying AI-assisted engineering tools to data development.

• Strong problem-solving mindset and commitment to engineering quality.

• Prior exposure to e-commerce platforms, two-sided marketplaces, or high-volume AdTech ecosystems is a plus.

 

What We Offer

  • Purpose-driven work at scale
    Join a company reshaping the fashion industry towards circularity, you directly contributes to reducing waste and extending the life of luxury items.
  • High-impact scope & ownership
    Work on products used globally, where your decisions have immediate, measurable impact on millions of users across 70+ countries.
  • A truly international environment
    Collaborate with a diverse team of 50+ nationalities across Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, and Ho Chi Minh City.
  • Career acceleration in a fast-moving scale-up
    Take ownership early, grow fast, and shape your path, as an expert or a future leader.
  • Learning & growth as a priority
    Dedicated budget, continuous feedback culture, and opportunities to work on cutting-edge topics (AI, marketplace dynamics, scalability, etc.).
  • Flexible ways of working
    Hybrid model (typically 2 days remote per week), with trust and autonomy at the core of how we operate.
  • Give back through action
    2 paid days per year to support a cause of your choice and actively contribute to positive impact beyond your day-to-day role.
  • Competitive compensation & benefits
    Including bonus, health coverage, lunch vouchers, Gym-Pass, and additional legal perks depending on your location.

Today, we are a team of around 600 people from over 50 nationalities, united by a shared ambition: to drive meaningful change in the fashion industry.
 
Our values, Activism, Transparency, Dedication, Greatness, and Collective, shape how we build, collaborate, and grow every day.

Vestiaire Collective is looking for a Performance Marketing Intern to join our team starting January 2027!

As part of the Performance Marketing team, you will contribute to the execution and optimization of our international paid media campaigns, helping drive qualified traffic, acquire new buyers, and grow our business.

The role focuses on national space strategy development, institutional assessments, and policy advisory, contributing to impactful projects across the global space ecosystem.

  • Conduct targeted research, quantitative and qualitative analyses to inform policy, regulatory and investment decision in the space domain 

  • Develop and maintain structured databases and analyse datasets (expetced) and build simple quantitative and economic models (a strong plus) to support consulting assignments.

  • Lead and participate to proposal development and business development activities, including shaping value propositions and supporting tender responses

Experience & Education

  • Up to 4 years of relevant professional experience (consulting, public sector advisory, or space-related roles) 

  • Strong academic background with a Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., space studies, engineering, economics, public policy, international relations, or equivalent) 

  • Knowledge of econometric methods and modelling is a strong asset. 


Required Skills

  • Strong analytical skills 

  • Excellent PowerPoint, Excel and written/oral communication skills 

  • Proven ability for research, synthesis, and structuring complex information 

  • Demonstrated interest or knowledge in the space sector 


We offer

  • Development of your management consultancy skill set

Benefits

  • Define and execute the global SDLC/DevEx practice strategy and business plan.

  • Build and lead a network of regional Practice Leads across EMEA, North America and APAC.

  • Lead executive client conversations with CTO, VP Engineering, CISO and equivalent stakeholders.

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Professional Services and Managed Services to generate and close strategic opportunities.

  • Lead structured discovery and gap analysis, translating business needs and maturity gaps into compelling modernisation visions and roadmaps.

  • Drive adoption of global standards, asset reuse and continuous improvement across regional teams.

  • Build practitioner capability through enablement, certifications, mentorship and knowledge management.

  • Maintain a strong market point of view on SDLC, DevEx, DevOps and emerging AI capabilities.

Practice focus

  • DevOps and CI/CD modernisation

  • Developer Experience and developer flow optimisation

  • Agentic AI and AI-assisted software development

  • SDLC governance, standardisation and quality engineering

  • Atlassian Software Collection adoption and enterprise SDLC modernisation

You will build a recognised global practice that:

  • Has a clear, differentiated portfolio of packaged and sellable solutions.

  • Converts expertise into repeatable IP and high-quality delivery.

  • Helps regional teams win and deliver strategic SDLC/DevEx engagements.

  • Creates measurable client value while supporting Valiantys’ growth and Next Generation revenue ambition.

  • Establishes Valiantys as a credible leader in AI-enabled software delivery transformation.

  • 10–15 years of experience in professional services, technology consulting, or enterprise software - with a significant portion spent in SDLC, DevOps, developer experience, or engineering tooling.

  • Commercially driven, with experience partnering across Sales, Marketing, Professional Services, and Managed Services to generate and close pipeline.

  • Experience operating across EMEA, AMER, and APAC - with a track record of driving adoption of global standards across distributed regional teams.

title: Technical Account Manager
description: Diabolocom est la solution souveraine leader en Europe pour les centres de contact cloud (CCaaS) et la gestion de l'expérience client. Elle transforme la relation client en alliant IA et expertise humaine, en automatisant les demandes récurrentes et en personnalisant les échanges. Fondée sur une IA propriétaire, un cloud privé et une infrastructure télécom native, la plateforme automatise les flux opérationnels, améliore la qualité des données et accompagne les équipes sur chaque canal. Forte de plus de vingt ans d’expérience et doublement récompensée par Frost & Sullivan pour son innovation en IA et son leadership en expérience client, Diabolocom accompagne plus de 400 entreprises, dont BPCE, Carrefour, MAIF et Mitsubishi, dans plus de 60 pays pour leurs opérations stratégiques.   A propos de ce poste :   En tant que Technical Account Manager (TAM), rôle combinant les tâches d’Account Manager et de Chef de Projet et rattaché au pôle des Opérations Clients et plus particulièrement au pôle d’Account Management, tu joues un rôle central dans la relation avec ton portefeuille clients, pour lequel tu seras l’interlocuteur technique et commercial privilégié. Tu les accompagnes de manière proactive dans la mise en œuvre, la configuration et l’optimisation de nos solutions de centre de contact et d’intelligence artificielle, en veillant constamment à leur satisfaction et à la résolution efficace de leurs problématiques métier. Tu seras responsable de la gestion et du développement commercial de ton portefeuille clients, en veillant à leur satisfaction et à leur fidélisation. Tu accompagneras les clients dans l’adoption de la solution et dans l’identification de nouvelles opportunités commerciales (upsell, cross-sell) pour lesquelles tu assureras toutes les étapes de la démonstration à la mise en place technique.  Chez Diabolocom, tu auras pour missions principales :    Paramétrage technique avancé : Accompagner les clients dans le paramétrage et l'utilisation optimale de nos solutions applicatives et télécom. Gestion du portefeuille client : Construire une relation de confiance avec les équipes techniques et métiers du client. Coordination interne : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Account Management, Project Management, Produit, Formation et Support sur des sujets transverses. Détection d’opportunités : Identifier les besoins additionnels et contribuer au développement du portefeuille clients global via la détection d’upsell et de cross-sell. Suivi de la satisfaction : Mettre en place et suivre des plans d’action pour maximiser la satisfaction et l'usage de nos services. Amélioration continue : Être force de proposition auprès des équipes internes pour améliorer nos produits et services en fonction du feedback client.     Tu es fait pour le poste si :  Tu as un diplôme Bac+4/5 dans une discipline technique pertinente, ou expérience équivalente  Tu peux te prévaloir de 1 à 3 ans d’expérience en tant que TAM, Ingénieur Support, Consultant Technique ou équivalent dans un environnement SaaS ou technologique incluant la maîtrise des API  Tu démontres une excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais professionnel (oral et écrit) Tu as de l’expérience dans l'accompagnement de comptes en autonomie  Tu as de l’appétence pour les sujets commerciaux Tu fais preuve d’une excellente capacité d’organisation et de priorisation, pour gérer efficacement un portefeuille clients en autonomie complète Tu disposes de très bonnes compétences en communication, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, avec une capacité à vulgariser des sujets techniques auprès d’interlocuteurs variés. Tu démontres une aisance relationnelle et un sens du service client, pour construire une relation de confiance dans la durée Ce que tu apprécieras chez Diabolocom : Tu bénéficieras d’un parcours d’intégration complet pour découvrir notre produit, nos équipes et notre culture ! Tu auras l’opportunité de travailler dans un environnement multiculturel Nous te fournissons un équipement informatique de premier choix Nos bureaux sont situés en plein cœur de Paris, à 100 mètres de l’Opéra Garnier ! Télétravail possible : jusqu’à 2 jours par semaine Titres-restaurants : 11 € / jour sur ta carte Swile Événements de team building dans des destinations comme la Corse, Marrakech ou Djerba Tu rejoindras une entreprise à un moment clé de sa croissance, avec de nombreuses opportunités à saisir Tu auras la chance d’intégrer une équipe assez grande pour se développer, mais aussi assez petite pour que ton impact sur le succès de l’entreprise soit réel ! Cette opportunité t’intéresse ? Discutons-en ! Nous serions ravis d’en apprendre plus sur toi ! Process de recrutement: - Call avec la Talent Acquisition Manager en charge du poste si ton CV correspond à nos attentes pour le poste. Vous pourrez aborder : ton expérience, tes attentes, pourquoi tu t’intéresses à Diabolocom (45/60 min) - Visio avec Axel, Senior Project Manager, pour tester tes connaissances côté technique (45 min) - On-site meeting avec Virginie, Technical Account Manager, et Audrey, Head of Project Management, pour une mise en situation et un échange sur tes compétences transverses et commerciales (60 min). - Le processus se conclura par un échange avec Constance, Head of Customer Operations et ta future Manager (30 min) At Diabolocom, diversity and inclusion are in our DNA. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to color, language, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national or social origin, opinion disability, age. As part of our hiring process, please note that any employment offer or service provider offer will be subject to a background check, including verification of your identity, educational credentials, and previous employment history. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Telnyx</strong></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.</span></em></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.</span></em></p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>The opportunity</strong></h2> <p>We're looking for a Director or VP of Product Marketing to lead that effort globally. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can connect deep technical understanding with positioning, distribution and commercial results. The title will reflect the experience and scope of the person we hire.</p> <p>A good product story matters, but a story alone isn't enough. The person in this role needs to turn our infrastructure into clear customer problems we solve, compelling reasons to choose Telnyx and practical ways to try it. A great sample application, integration or reference architecture can do more than another 30-slide deck. So can a precise message that reaches a developer at the moment they are deciding how to build.</p> <p>You'll work across Product, Engineering, Developer Relations, Sales and Marketing to bring those pieces together. You'll help shape what we launch, how we explain it, how buyers discover it and how our field teams take it to market.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll build</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A coherent product story. Own positioning, segmentation and competitive differentiation across AI inference, Voice AI, agent and edge infrastructure, communications, networking and wireless. Make the full platform understandable without flattening the technical details that make it valuable.</li> <li>Solutions people can actually use. Drive the packaging of sample apps, reference architectures, integrations, templates and working demos that prove what the infrastructure makes possible. Build repeatable plays for use cases such as contact centers, agent assist and industry-specific workflows. These should accelerate adoption and enterprise sales, not become disconnected software products.</li> <li>Distribution that reaches technical buyers. Shape how we win discovery through product pages, developer content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), technical communities and paid acquisition. You won't necessarily operate every campaign, but you must understand the mechanics deeply enough to direct them: search and answer-engine visibility, technical site structure, intent, targeting, conversion paths, attribution and economics.</li> <li>A field-ready commercial engine. Give enterprise sellers, FDEs and solutions teams the pitches, discovery frameworks, architecture diagrams, competitive proof, demos and ROI narratives they need to generate and advance opportunities. Translate platform capabilities into buying reasons for developers, technical executives and enterprise decision-makers.</li> <li>Launches that translate into adoption. Work with Product and Engineering early, not after something ships. Choose the audience, packaging and launch strategy, then measure activation, qualified demand, field utilization and downstream pipeline. Build an operating cadence that keeps pace with a rapidly changing roadmap.</li> <li>An AI-native PMM team. Use AI research tools, coding assistants, agents and automation as part of everyday work to accelerate market research, competitive analysis, messaging tests, content production, demo development and go-to-market execution. Know when to trust those tools, how to evaluate outputs and where human technical judgment still matters. Lead the team to operate the same way.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>How we'll measure success</strong></h2> <p>The ultimate measure is pipeline. Not the number of launches, assets, impressions or campaigns. We expect this leader to partner closely with Demand Generation and Sales to create measurable, qualified pipeline, improve conversion and accelerate opportunities. Product marketing should be able to show how specific product narratives, solutions, integrations and programs contribute to commercial results.</p> <p>Early wins will look like a dramatically clearer platform story; a small number of flagship use cases with runnable demos and integrations; sellers using consistent, technically credible plays; stronger discovery and conversion from search, AEO and paid channels; and a repeatable link from product launches to adoption and pipeline. We care about what works and scales, not activity for its own sake.</p> <h2><strong>What we're looking for</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You've led product marketing for a complex B2B technical platform, ideally in AI infrastructure, developer tools, APIs, cloud, networking or communications. You can be strategic without becoming removed from the work.</li> <li>You are technically fluent. You can understand architecture, work with APIs or SDKs, interrogate a latency or cost claim and talk comfortably with engineers. You don't have to be a production engineer, but you need to know when a demo is real and when it's just a pitch.</li> <li>You understand modern technical acquisition. You're credible directing AEO, SEO, paid programs and developer-focused content, and can connect channel-level metrics to funnel economics and qualified pipeline.</li> <li>You're already effective with AI tools and agents in your own work. You experiment, build workflows and use the technology to move faster. Familiarity with the limitations and evaluation of AI-generated outputs is as important as enthusiasm for the tools.</li> <li>You write exceptionally well, have strong instincts for enterprise sales, and know how to turn a complex product advantage into a clear reason to buy.</li> <li>You've built or led strong teams, can prioritize across competing launches and products, and enjoy working directly with product leaders and technical builders.</li> </ul> <p>Telecom experience is not required. Technical curiosity, taste, speed and a track record of generating commercial impact matter more.</p> <h2><strong>Why Telnyx</strong></h2> <p>This is a chance to shape the market narrative for a company that owns the underlying network, communications and compute infrastructure it sells. The platform is real, customers are deploying it in production, and the commercial opportunity is substantial. You'll have direct access to senior leadership and the ability to build a PMM function measured by its contribution to growth.</p> <h4><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></h4> <p>Telnyx is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from different backgrounds and evaluate candidates based on the skills and experience relevant to the role.</p> <h3><span style="font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px;">#LI-RH1</span></h3><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

At Orakl Oncology, we combine patient-derived tumor models, experimental drug screening and computational modelling to improve oncology drug development. Our research brings together functional treatment-response measurements, molecular profiles and clinical information where available, creating opportunities to investigate how experimental responses translate into patient outcomes. Our platforms are designed to help anticipate clinical trial outcomes, evaluate therapies and identify new therapeutic opportunities.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

About the Role

We are looking for an Alliance & Delivery Manager to own Orakl's pharma partnerships after signature: the partner relationship, the delivery of each research program, and the growth of each account.

Orakl runs research programs for pharmaceutical companies on its virtual patient cohorts, combining compound screening, multi-omics and O-Predict analyses on the partner's assets. Several programs run in parallel on the same wet-lab and dry-lab teams, and the portfolio is growing. Delivery quality directly drives renewals and follow-on contracts.

This is a high-ownership, partner-facing role. You are the partner's main contact, you are accountable for delivery across our wet-lab and dry-lab teams, and you grow existing accounts. You will also scale our delivery processes and tooling: project tracking, capacity planning and partner reporting, automated wherever possible.

You will work closely with the Scientific Program & Operations Lead, Business Development, the Wet Lab, Data Science and Computational Biology leads, and Product. As the ideal candidate, you have already delivered complex scientific programs for pharma clients, and you are an expert at establishing partner trust.

What You'll Do

Own partner relationships: act as the main point of contact for each pharma partner from kick-off to final delivery. Map decision-makers, priorities and expectations for their asset, run the steering committees, attend key international conferences a few times per year and present results alongside our scientific teams.

Lead program delivery: translate each signed contract into an executable plan for the Wet Lab and Dry Lab teams, with owners, milestones and deliverables. Own the timeline, coordinate the experimental and computational work, and ensure every deliverable passes internal QC and review before it reaches the partner.

Manage capacity across programs: plan capacity with the Wet Lab and Dry Lab leads, arbitrate conflicts between programs and protect committed timelines. Centralise requests on delivery teams coming from partners and Business Development.

Manage risk and change: anticipate delivery risks, including results that change the plan, and escalate to the Scientific Program & Operations Lead with a recommendation. Agree and document scope and timeline changes with partners.

Scale delivery processes and tooling: scale our project management system in Asana, from program templates and timelines to portfolio and capacity views. Automate reporting and follow-up, deploy AI tools where they remove manual work, and document how we run programs.

Grow existing accounts: identify, qualify and convert follow-on opportunities within existing partnerships. Work with Business Development on scoping, proposals and pricing, and provide a feasibility assessment before anything is committed.

Plan scientific and BD materials: schedule conference and BD material cycles as part of the delivery plan, and coordinate partner approvals for any communication based on partnered programs.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years in project management, alliance and/or account management, or partner delivery in biotech, pharma, a CRO or a techbio.

  • Master's degree in a scientific or engineering field. A PhD is a strong plus.

  • Demonstrated delivery of complex scientific programs: you have led multidisciplinary projects from plan to final deliverable, including when results reshaped the plan.

  • Pharma-facing experience: you have managed pharma stakeholders through steering committees, negative results and scope negotiations.

  • Commercial track record: you have identified and converted follow-on opportunities within existing accounts.

  • Hands-on systems building: you have designed project management systems and automated recurring workflows.

  • Working knowledge of oncology or molecular biology, sufficient to lead scientific discussions with our teams and partners.

  • Fluent in English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in precision oncology or at a pharma-facing CRO.

  • Familiarity with patient-derived tumor models, omics or drug screening.

  • Scripting (Python) or experience deploying automation and AI tools.

  • Experience working with SOWs and contracts.

  • Professional French.

Who You Are

  • An owner: you take responsibility for outcomes across teams you do not manage, and you make explicit trade-offs when programs compete.

  • Scientifically fluent: you understand what a result means for the partner's asset before you plan around it.

  • Steady under pressure: you replan quickly if the data changes, and you deliver difficult news to partners clearly and early.

  • A builder: you treat every recurring manual task as something to standardise or automate.

  • Commercially minded: you recognise when a partner's needs extend beyond the signed scope and turn it into a proposal.

Why Join Orakl

  • Own a portfolio of pharma partnerships. Represent Orakl from signature to final delivery, with direct access to partner decision-makers.

  • Work on distinctive science. Deliver programs built on virtual patients cohorts, functional drug screening & multi-omics.

  • Build the delivery model. Design how Orakl runs partnered programs as the portfolio scales.

  • Work across disciplines every day. Alongside the biologists, data scientists and computational biologists who generate the results.

  • Help shape the team. Define the delivery capabilities and future team needs as the partnership portfolio grows.

Interview Process

  1. Hiring Manager Call: align on motivation, role scope and expectations.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: discuss a pharma program you delivered: the plan, the problems, how you managed the partner and the outcome.

  3. Delivery Case: using an anonymised, representative scenario, build a plan, triage issues and prepare a steering committee. Present it to the team.

  4. Reference Call: speak with one or two people who have seen you manage partners and deliver programs.

  5. Founder Interview: discuss Orakl's partnership strategy and mutual ambitions.

Come build our France territory. You'll own the market, lead from the front in every deal, and build the team as the market earns it.

  • We win 86% of live RFPs against our biggest competitor

  • More than 3x ARR growth in the last 12 months, with 40% in Q3 alone

  • Under 20% of enterprises use modern procurement software today. Gartner expects that to reach 50% by 2027

  • Own the France number: set the territory plan, choose the target accounts and build pipeline from day one

  • Be in the deals: run and close our biggest France opportunities yourself, with CFOs, CPOs and procurement leaders

  • Lead from the front as Omnea's face in France: customer meetings, CFO dinners, industry events and partner conversations

  • Build the team as the market earns it: hire and coach the AEs who follow you, and set the standard they sell to

  • Take what you hear from buyers straight to product and marketing, so we win more in France

Who this is for

  • 8+ years in B2B SaaS, with a strong record of closing complex enterprise new business yourself

  • Experience leading or building a sales team, ideally in a new market or a fast-growing business

  • Fluent French and English

  • A player-coach who would rather be in the deal than in a dashboard

  • Credible with C-suite buyers, especially Finance, Procurement and Legal

  • Comfortable building from zero: no local team and no playbook handed to you, just a proven product and a market to win

This role is remote while we build our presence in France.

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

Le centre SPIN (Science des Procédés Industriels et Naturels), qui sera fortement impliqué dans la thèse, développe, au sein de Mines Saint-Etienne, son expertise dans le domaine du Génie des Procédés appliqué aux systèmes dispersés : grains, particules, gouttes, bulles, milieux poreux.
